title: Navijači BiH bakljama i pjesmom krenuli prema stadionu u Zenici
BiH fans set off for the stadium in Zenica with torches and songs
body: Navijači BH Fanaticosi u utorak navečer prošli su ulicama Zenice prema stadionu Bilino polje.
On Tuesday evening, the BH Fanaticos fans walked through the streets of Zenica towards the Bilino polje stadium.
Okupili su se oko 18 sati, a zatim su uz pjesmu i mnogo baklji krenuli u korteo.
They gathered around 18:00 and then set off in a procession with songs and many torches.
Bosna i Hercegovina večeras u 20:45 igra protiv Rumunije u posljednjem kolu Lige nacija.
Tonight at 20:45, Bosnia and Herzegovina plays Romania in the last round of the Nations League.
Policija je bila prisutna na ulicama, jer je MUP Zeničko-dobojskog kantona utakmicu označio kao rizičnu.
Police were present on the streets because the Interior Ministry of Zenica-Doboj Canton marked the match as risky.
Na ulazima u stadion najavljeni su detaljni pregledi, a ulaz je otvoren u 17:45.
Detailed checks were announced at the stadium entrances, and the gates opened at 17:45.
Sve ulaznice su prodane, pa će stadion biti pun.
All the tickets have been sold, so the stadium will be full.
BiH je već osigurala drugo mjesto u grupi i baraž za ulazak u Ligu A.
BiH has already secured second place in the group and a play-off for entry into League A.
Prošle godine situacija je bila drugačija, kada su BH Fanaticosi bojkotovali utakmicu protiv Rumunije.
Last year the situation was different, when the BH Fanaticos boycotted the match against Romania.
Tada su ostali ispred stadiona zbog spora sa Nogometnim savezom BiH oko ulaznica.
At that time they stayed in front of the stadium because of a dispute with the Football Association of BiH over tickets.
Rumuniji je potrebna pobjeda kako ne bi završila na posljednjem mjestu u grupi.
Romania needs a win so that it does not finish last in the group.
Utakmicu prenose BHT i MY TV, a Klix.ba ima i tekstualni prijenos uživo.
The match is broadcast by BHT and MY TV, and Klix.ba also has live text coverage.

title: Čović i Cvijanović na kraju mandata podijelili 102.500 KM
Čović and Cvijanović handed out 102,500 KM at the end of their term
body: Članica Predsjedništva Željka Cvijanović i Dragan Čović podijelili su 102.500 KM iz interventne rezerve.
Presidency member Željka Cvijanović and Dragan Čović handed out 102,500 KM from the intervention reserve.
To je novac iz budžeta koji se daje za hitne i posebne potrebe.
That is money from the budget that is given for urgent and special needs.
Odluke su danas objavljene u Službenom glasniku BiH, a donesene su pred kraj njihovog mandata.
The decisions were published today in the Official Gazette of BiH, and they were made near the end of their term.
Cvijanović je donijela 15 odluka i podijelila 91.500 KM.
Cvijanović made 15 decisions and handed out 91,500 KM.
Osam udruženja dobilo je ukupno 85.000 KM, a najviše je dobilo udruženje za razvoj seoskog turizma, 20.000 KM.
Eight associations received a total of 85,000 KM, and the most went to an association for the development of rural tourism, 20,000 KM.
Sedam osoba dobilo je 6.500 KM, uglavnom za liječenje ili jednokratnu pomoć.
Seven people received 6,500 KM, mostly for medical treatment or one-off help.
Čović je potpisao četiri odluke vrijedne 11.000 KM.
Čović signed four decisions worth 11,000 KM.
Od tog novca, džudo klub Borsa iz Mostara dobio je 5.000 KM, a župa u Husinu 4.000 KM.
From that money, the Borsa judo club from Mostar received 5,000 KM, and the parish in Husino 4,000 KM.
Po 1.000 KM dobile su i dvije osobe iz Sarajeva i Fojnice.
Two people from Sarajevo and Fojnica also received 1,000 KM each.
Svi koji su dobili novac moraju u roku od šest mjeseci podnijeti izvještaj o tome kako su ga potrošili.
Everyone who received money must submit a report within six months on how they spent it.

title: Zašto smo umorni nakon ručka i šta može pomoći
Why we are tired after lunch and what can help
body: Mnogi ljudi poslije ručka osjećaju umor, čak i kada dovoljno spavaju i zdravo jedu.
Many people feel tired after lunch, even when they sleep enough and eat healthily.
Medicinska sestra Martha Santiago objašnjava da je to normalan dio ritma tijela.
Nurse Martha Santiago explains that this is a normal part of the body's rhythm.
Unutrašnji sat tijela utiče na to da je pažnja najslabija u ranim popodnevnim satima.
The body's internal clock causes attention to be weakest in the early afternoon hours.
Žvakaća guma bez šećera može malo podići budnost, ali taj efekat brzo prolazi.
Sugar-free chewing gum can raise alertness a little, but that effect passes quickly.
Pomaže i hladna voda na licu, a u prostoriji bi trebalo biti oko 20 do 22 stepena.
Cold water on the face also helps, and the room should be about 20 to 22 degrees.
Dnevno svjetlo govori mozgu da treba ostati budan, čak i kada je oblačno.
Daylight tells the brain that it should stay awake, even when it is cloudy.
Kratka šetnja nakon jela pomaže mišićima da koriste šećer iz krvi.
A short walk after a meal helps the muscles use sugar from the blood.
Santiago savjetuje da na stolu uvijek imate bocu vode, jer ljudi ponekad žeđ zamijene za umor.
Santiago advises always keeping a bottle of water on the desk, because people sometimes mistake thirst for tiredness.
Kafa pomaže, ali kasno popodne može pokvariti san.
Coffee helps, but late in the afternoon it can spoil sleep.
Za čitanje i pisanje preporučuje muziku bez riječi, a za lakše poslove brže pjesme.
For reading and writing she recommends music without lyrics, and faster songs for easier tasks.

title: Jensen Huang priznao greške i spreman je vratiti se u Nvidiju
Jensen Huang admitted mistakes and is ready to return to Nvidia
body: Bivši direktor kompanije Nvidia Jensen Huang prvi put se javno oglasio nakon ostavke.
Former Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has spoken publicly for the first time since his resignation.
U pisanoj izjavi, koju je dobio CNBC, priznao je da je napravio ozbiljne greške.
In a written statement, which CNBC obtained, he admitted that he had made serious mistakes.
Rekao je da preuzima punu odgovornost i da će sarađivati u istrazi koju vodi uprava kompanije.
He said he takes full responsibility and will cooperate in the investigation led by the company's board.
Huang je osnovao Nvidiju 1993. godine i vodio je više od 30 godina.
Huang founded Nvidia in 1993 and led it for more than 30 years.
U oktobru su mediji pisali o njegovoj vezi sa ženom za koju američke službe sumnjaju da je radila za Kinu.
In October, the media wrote about his relationship with a woman whom US agencies suspect of working for China.
Uprava je 8. novembra pokrenula istragu, a Huang je 12. novembra dao ostavku.
The board launched an investigation on 8 November, and Huang resigned on 12 November.
Kompaniju sada privremeno vodi finansijska direktorica Colette Kress.
The company is now temporarily run by chief financial officer Colette Kress.
Huang je napisao da ga radnici, investitori i kupci mole da se vrati.
Huang wrote that workers, investors and customers are asking him to come back.
Ako uprava odluči da je to dobro za kompaniju, rado bi ponovo postao direktor.
If the board decides that it is good for the company, he would gladly become chief executive again.
Ipak, jedan izvor rekao je CNBC-u da uprava ne razmišlja o njegovom povratku i da traži novog direktora.
However, a source told CNBC that the board is not considering his return and is looking for a new chief executive.

title: Strani radnici u FBiH bez diplome neće dobiti radnu dozvolu
Foreign workers in FBiH will not get a work permit without a diploma
body: Strani državljani u Federaciji BiH više ne mogu dobiti radnu dozvolu samo na osnovu certifikata.
Foreign citizens in the Federation of BiH can no longer get a work permit on the basis of a certificate alone.
Federalno ministarstvo obrazovanja i nauke saopćilo je da je sada potrebna diploma.
The Federal Ministry of Education and Science announced that a diploma is now required.
Novi pravilnik o radnim dozvolama počeo je važiti 12. novembra.
The new rulebook on work permits came into force on 12 November.
Diploma mora biti prevedena na jedan od službenih jezika, a potreban je i dokaz da je priznata u BiH.
The diploma must be translated into one of the official languages, and proof that it is recognised in BiH is also needed.
Osnovne i srednje diplome priznaju kantonalna ministarstva, a fakultetske diplome univerziteti.
Primary and secondary diplomas are recognised by cantonal ministries, and university diplomas by universities.
Ministarstvo moli poslodavce da više ne traže priznavanje certifikata samo zbog dozvole, kako ne bi plaćali taksu od 35 KM.
The ministry asks employers to stop requesting recognition of certificates just for a permit, so that they do not pay a 35 KM fee.
Ko povuče svoj zahtjev, može tražiti da mu se taksa vrati.
Whoever withdraws their request can ask for the fee to be returned.
Prije izdavanja dozvole, služba za zapošljavanje provjerava da li neki nezaposleni domaći radnik može dobiti taj posao.
Before a permit is issued, the employment service checks whether an unemployed local worker could get that job.
Ako domaći kandidat prihvati posao, dozvola se ne može izdati.
If a local candidate accepts the job, the permit cannot be issued.
Radna dozvola važi najviše godinu dana, a odluka se mora donijeti u roku od 30 dana.
A work permit is valid for at most one year, and a decision must be made within 30 days.

title: Netflixova serija The Body hit, ali hiljade ljudi traže ukidanje
Netflix series The Body is a hit, but thousands want it cancelled
body: Nova Netflixova horor serija The Body brzo je postala jedna od najgledanijih na svijetu.
Netflix's new horror series The Body quickly became one of the most watched in the world.
Samo nekoliko dana nakon premijere došla je na prvo mjesto globalne liste.
Only a few days after its premiere, it reached first place on the global chart.
Ipak, mnogi ljudi potpisuju peticiju u kojoj traže da Netflix ukine seriju.
However, many people are signing a petition asking Netflix to cancel the series.
Do 13. novembra peticiju je potpisalo oko 84.000 ljudi, a cilj je 100.000 potpisa.
By 13 November, about 84,000 people had signed the petition, and the goal is 100,000 signatures.
Potpisnici kažu da serija vrijeđa kršćane i njihovu vjeru.
The signers say that the series insults Christians and their faith.
Serija ima osam epizoda, a radnja se dešava u katoličkoj školi 2004. godine.
The series has eight episodes, and the story takes place in a Catholic school in 2004.
Nakon jednog rituala djevojke iz plesne grupe počinju imati čudne vizije, pa u mjestu nastaje panika.
After a ritual, the girls from the dance group start having strange visions, so panic spreads in the town.
Netflix do sada nije komentarisao peticiju.
So far, Netflix has not commented on the petition.
Autorica serije Quinn Shephard rekla je da serija kritikuje one koji zloupotrebljavaju vjeru, ali pokazuje i njenu ljepotu.
The creator of the series, Quinn Shephard, said that the series criticises those who misuse faith but also shows its beauty.
Kritičari su seriju dobro ocijenili, a na IMDb-u ima ocjenu 7,6.
Critics rated the series well, and it has a rating of 7.6 on IMDb.

title: U bankama u BiH 41 milijarda KM, većina pripada građanima
41 billion KM in banks in BiH, most of it belongs to citizens
body: U bankama u Bosni i Hercegovini krajem septembra bilo je 41,05 milijardi KM depozita.
At the end of September, there were 41.05 billion KM in deposits in banks in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Podatke je objavila Centralna banka BiH, a više od polovine novca pripada građanima.
The data was published by the Central Bank of BiH, and more than half of the money belongs to citizens.
U odnosu na august, depoziti su porasli za 145,6 miliona KM.
Compared with August, deposits rose by 145.6 million KM.
Građani u bankama imaju 21,39 milijardi KM, što je oko 52 posto svih depozita.
Citizens have 21.39 billion KM in banks, which is about 52 percent of all deposits.
Samo u septembru njihova štednja povećala se za 208,2 miliona KM.
In September alone, their savings increased by 208.2 million KM.
Privatne firme imaju 9,37 milijardi KM, a jedino su vladine institucije imale manje novca nego mjesec ranije.
Private companies have 9.37 billion KM, and only government institutions had less money than a month earlier.
Njihovi depoziti pali su za 192,2 miliona KM, na 5,9 milijardi KM.
Their deposits fell by 192.2 million KM, to 5.9 billion KM.
Za godinu dana ukupni depoziti porasli su za 4,82 milijarde KM, odnosno 13,3 posto.
In one year, total deposits grew by 4.82 billion KM, or 13.3 percent.
Građani najviše novca drže na tekućim računima, i to 51,4 posto.
Citizens keep most of their money in current accounts, 51.4 percent.
Oročeni depoziti čine 29,3 posto, a ostatak je novac koji se može podići bilo kada.
Term deposits make up 29.3 percent, and the rest is money that can be withdrawn at any time.

title: Koljić prije meča u Zenici: Bit će vatrena utakmica
Koljić before the match in Zenica: It will be a fiery game
body: Bh. napadač Elvir Koljić najavio je večerašnju utakmicu BiH i Rumunije u Zenici.
Bosnian striker Elvir Koljić previewed tonight's match between BiH and Romania in Zenica.
Koljić je ranije igrao za rumunske klubove Craiovu i Rapid, a sada igra u grčkom Iraklisu.
Koljić used to play for the Romanian clubs Craiova and Rapid, and he now plays for Greek club Iraklis.
Rumunskom listu Gazeta Sporturilor rekao je da očekuje vatrenu atmosferu.
He told the Romanian paper Gazeta Sporturilor that he expects a fiery atmosphere.
Prema njegovim riječima, BiH je pod selektorom Sergejem Barbarezom napravila dobar tim s mladim igračima.
According to him, BiH under head coach Sergej Barbarez has built a good team with young players.
Nada se da će igrati Jovo Lukić, s kojim je igrao u Krupi i Craiovi.
He hopes that Jovo Lukić, with whom he played at Krupa and Craiova, will play.
Lukić nije igrao u porazu od Švedske, ali je Barbarez rekao da je spreman.
Lukić did not play in the defeat against Sweden, but Barbarez said that he is ready.
Koljić misli da Rumunija može pobijediti, jer vjeruje u selektora Gheorghea Hagija.
Koljić thinks that Romania can win because he believes in head coach Gheorghe Hagi.
Rumunija je posljednja u grupi i mora pobijediti u Zenici.
Romania is last in the group and must win in Zenica.
Koljić je za reprezentaciju BiH odigrao četiri utakmice, posljednju 2020. godine.
Koljić played four matches for the BiH national team, the last one in 2020.
Utakmica počinje u 20:45 na Bilinom polju, a prenosi je BHT1.
The match starts at 20:45 at Bilino polje, and BHT1 is broadcasting it.

title: Iznad gradova sada je više satelita nego vidljivih zvijezda
Above cities there are now more satellites than visible stars
body: Iznad većine gradova noću sada ima više satelita nego zvijezda koje vidimo golim okom.
Above most cities at night there are now more satellites than stars that we can see with the naked eye.
To pokazuje analiza kompanije Accu Components, koju još nisu provjerili drugi naučnici.
This is shown by an analysis by the company Accu Components, which other scientists have not yet checked.
Analiza je obuhvatila 15.833 aktivna satelita u niskoj orbiti oko Zemlje.
The analysis covered 15,833 active satellites in low orbit around the Earth.
Iznad prosječnog britanskog grada u svakom trenutku ima oko 710 satelita.
Above an average British city there are about 710 satellites at any moment.
Oko 105 njih vidljivo je, jer satelite vidimo samo kada ih obasjava Sunce, a na zemlji je već mrak.
About 105 of them are visible, because we see satellites only when the Sun lights them up and it is already dark on the ground.
Slično je u većem dijelu Evrope i SAD-a, ali i u Bosni i Hercegovini.
It is similar in most of Europe and the USA, but also in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Iznad velikih gradova kao što su London i New York u ponoć se vidi samo nekoliko desetina zvijezda.
Above big cities such as London and New York, only a few dozen stars can be seen at midnight.
Broj satelita jako je porastao nakon što je SpaceX počeo lansirati satelite Starlink.
The number of satellites has risen sharply since SpaceX started launching Starlink satellites.
Kompanije planiraju još stotine hiljada satelita u narednim decenijama.
Companies are planning hundreds of thousands more satellites in the coming decades.
Astronomi su zabrinuti, jer sateliti ostavljaju tragove na snimcima teleskopa i čine nebo svjetlijim.
Astronomers are worried because satellites leave trails on telescope images and make the sky brighter.

title: Automobil udario reporterku tokom javljanja uživo
Car hits a reporter during a live broadcast
body: Automobil je u utorak udario reporterku Radio-televizije Vojvodine dok se javljala uživo iz Stare Pazove.
On Tuesday a car hit a reporter of Radio-Television Vojvodina while she was reporting live from Stara Pazova.
Kamera je snimila cijeli događaj, a snimak se brzo proširio na društvenim mrežama.
The camera recorded the whole event, and the footage quickly spread on social networks.
Na snimku se vidi kako vozilo izlazi unazad s parkinga i udara reporterku.
The footage shows a vehicle reversing out of a parking space and hitting the reporter.
Ona izgleda zbunjeno i pokušava se skloniti s puta.
She looks confused and tries to get out of the way.
Prema pisanju srbijanskih medija, vozač je nakon udarca nastavio voziti.
According to Serbian media reports, the driver continued driving after the impact.
Zasad se ne zna da li je reporterka povrijeđena.
For now it is not known whether the reporter was injured.
RTV Vojvodina još nije komentarisala ovaj događaj.
RTV Vojvodina has not yet commented on this event.
Reporterka se javila na mreži X, gdje koristi ime „Mokoš“.
The reporter posted on the X network, where she uses the name "Mokoš".
Podsjetila je da je prije nekoliko godina, dok je čitala vremensku prognozu, pas iza nje povraćao pred kamerom.
She recalled that a few years ago, while she was reading the weather forecast, a dog behind her vomited in front of the camera.

title: Rumunski novinari ušli na teren stadiona u Zenici
Romanian journalists walk onto the pitch of the stadium in Zenica
body: Novinari rumunskog sportskog portala Golazo.ro jutros su ušli na travnjak stadiona Bilino polje u Zenici.
Journalists from the Romanian sports portal Golazo.ro this morning walked onto the grass of the Bilino polje stadium in Zenica.
Večeras u 21:45 na tom stadionu igraju reprezentacije BiH i Rumunije u Ligi nacija.
Tonight at 21:45 the national teams of BiH and Romania play at that stadium in the Nations League.
Čuvar ih na ulazu prvo nije htio pustiti, ali je popustio kada su rekli da će ostati samo jednu minutu.
At the entrance the guard at first did not want to let them in, but he gave in when they said they would stay only one minute.
Prolaz između tribina bio je otvoren, pa su otišli direktno na travu.
The passage between the stands was open, so they went straight onto the grass.
Tada je domar stadiona počeo vikati i zabranio fotografisanje.
Then the stadium caretaker started shouting and banned taking photos.
Kasnije se smirio i dozvolio im da teren slikaju mobitelima, ali ne profesionalnim kamerama.
Later he calmed down and allowed them to photograph the pitch with mobile phones, but not with professional cameras.
Novinari su napisali da teren ima tamne mrlje i male neravnine, ali da je dobar za igru.
The journalists wrote that the pitch has dark spots and small bumps, but that it is good for playing.
Iako je posljednjih dana padala jaka kiša, jutros je bilo sunčano i toplije.
Although heavy rain fell in recent days, this morning it was sunny and warmer.
Prema njihovom mišljenju, teren je skoro isti kao 15. novembra 2025., kada je BiH pobijedila Rumuniju 3:1.
In their opinion, the pitch is almost the same as on 15 November 2025, when BiH beat Romania 3:1.

title: Zastupnik SDP-a iz Tuzle pretresen na aerodromu u Beogradu
SDP representative from Tuzla searched at Belgrade airport
body: Dževad Hadžić, poznati političar SDP-a iz Tuzle, kaže da je u Srbiji više puta zaustavljen i pretresen.
Dževad Hadžić, a well-known SDP politician from Tuzla, says that he was stopped and searched several times in Serbia.
Hadžić je predsjednik SDP-a u Tuzlanskom kantonu i delegat u Domu naroda Parlamenta Federacije BiH.
Hadžić is the president of the SDP in Tuzla Canton and a delegate in the House of Peoples of the Parliament of the Federation of BiH.
Prvo su ga zaustavili na graničnom prelazu Karakaj, gdje su ga ispitivali oko 40 minuta.
First they stopped him at the Karakaj border crossing, where they questioned him for about 40 minutes.
Na povratku su ga na beogradskom aerodromu izdvojili iz redovne kontrole.
On the way back they separated him from the regular check at Belgrade airport.
Policajci su pregledali njegove lične stvari i dokumente.
Police officers examined his personal belongings and documents.
Pitali su ga gdje je boravio, kuda putuje i odakle je automobil kojim je došao na aerodrom.
They asked him where he had stayed, where he was travelling and where the car he came to the airport in was from.
Kada je pitao zašto ga provjeravaju, rekli su mu da rade po nalogu BIA-e, srbijanske sigurnosne agencije.
When he asked why they were checking him, they told him they were acting on the order of the BIA, the Serbian security agency.
Nakon pretresa i ispitivanja pušten je, ali nije dobio objašnjenje.
After the search and questioning he was released, but he did not get an explanation.
Hadžić je rekao da su slično iskustvo imala još trojica zastupnika iz drugih stranaka.
Hadžić said that three other representatives from other parties had a similar experience.
Srbijanske vlasti zasad nisu objasnile razloge za ove kontrole.
The Serbian authorities have not explained the reasons for these checks so far.

title: Američke banke ne žele finansirati Južnu interkonekciju
US banks do not want to finance the Southern Interconnection
body: Američko finansiranje velikih projekata kompanije AAFS u Bosni i Hercegovini je pod upitnikom, piše agencija Bloomberg.
US financing of the large projects of the company AAFS in Bosnia and Herzegovina is in question, the Bloomberg agency writes.
Riječ je o projektima vrijednim 2,3 milijarde dolara, a među njima su gasovod Južna interkonekcija i aerodromi u Sarajevu i Mostaru.
These are projects worth 2.3 billion dollars, and among them are the Southern Interconnection gas pipeline and the airports in Sarajevo and Mostar.
Dvije američke razvojne banke sada se ograđuju od tog plana.
Two American development banks are now distancing themselves from that plan.
Glasnogovornik banke EXIM rekao je da banka trenutno nije odobrila nikakav novac za kompaniju.
A spokesperson for the EXIM bank said that the bank has currently not approved any money for the company.
Izvor upoznat sa situacijom rekao je Bloombergu da ni u banci DFC projekat ne ide naprijed.
A source familiar with the situation told Bloomberg that the project is not moving forward at the DFC bank either.
Kompaniju AAFS vode Jesse Binnall, bivši advokat Donalda Trumpa, i Joseph Flynn, brat Trumpovog bivšeg savjetnika.
The company AAFS is run by Jesse Binnall, Donald Trump's former lawyer, and Joseph Flynn, the brother of Trump's former adviser.
Šef AAFS-a u BiH Amer Bekan potvrdio je da su razgovori s bankom EXIM prekinuti.
The head of AAFS in BiH, Amer Bekan, confirmed that the talks with the EXIM bank have been stopped.
Bekan je rekao da kompanija pregovara s drugim investitorima i da već ima do 450 miliona eura za gasovod.
Bekan said that the company is negotiating with other investors and already has up to 450 million euros for the pipeline.
On očekuje da AAFS uskoro potpiše ugovor s Vladom Federacije BiH i kaže da se projekti nastavljaju.
He expects AAFS to soon sign a contract with the Government of the Federation of BiH and says the projects are continuing.
Južna interkonekcija bi preko Hrvatske povezala BiH s evropskom mrežom gasa.
The Southern Interconnection would connect BiH with the European gas network via Croatia.
Tako BiH više ne bi zavisila samo od ruskog gasa.
That way BiH would no longer depend only on Russian gas.

title: Evropska komisija: Temu ne štiti kupce od opasnih proizvoda
European Commission: Temu does not protect buyers from dangerous products
body: Evropska komisija je utvrdila da platforma za online kupovinu Temu vjerovatno krši pravila Evropske unije.
The European Commission has found that the online shopping platform Temu is probably breaking European Union rules.
Riječ je o Aktu o digitalnim uslugama, zakonu koji velikim platformama propisuje obaveze prema korisnicima.
This is the Digital Services Act, a law that sets obligations towards users for large platforms.
Prema Komisiji, Temu ne radi dovoljno da spriječi prodaju nezakonitih proizvoda.
According to the Commission, Temu does not do enough to prevent the sale of illegal products.
Temu traži izvještaje o testiranju za vrlo malo proizvoda, a često ih ni ne provjerava.
Temu asks for test reports for very few products, and often does not even check them.
Igračke, elektronika i kozmetika smatraju se rizičnim, ali ne dobijaju prednost pri fizičkim kontrolama.
Toys, electronics and cosmetics are considered risky, but they do not get priority in physical inspections.
Broj proizvoda na platformi stalno raste, ali broj kontrola i zaposlenih koji pregledaju oglase nije porastao.
The number of products on the platform keeps growing, but the number of checks and of staff who review listings has not grown.
Komisija kaže i da kazne za prodavače nisu dovoljno jake.
The Commission also says that the penalties for sellers are not strong enough.
Ovo su preliminarni nalazi, što znači da konačna odluka još nije donesena.
These are preliminary findings, which means that a final decision has not yet been made.
Temu ima pravo vidjeti dokumente Komisije i pismeno odgovoriti na nalaze.
Temu has the right to see the Commission's documents and to respond to the findings in writing.
Komisija će se konsultovati i s Evropskim odborom za digitalne usluge.
The Commission will also consult with the European Board for Digital Services.

title: Čavara dobio mandat u Domu naroda, ali ga vjerovatno neće prihvatiti
Čavara gets a mandate in the House of Peoples but will probably not accept it
body: Centralna izborna komisija BiH (CIK) danas je dodijelila Marinku Čavari mandat u Domu naroda Parlamentarne skupštine BiH.
The Central Election Commission of BiH (CIK) today assigned Marinko Čavara a mandate in the House of Peoples of the Parliamentary Assembly of BiH.
On je mandat dobio nakon što je Marina Pendeš dala ostavku na mjesto delegatkinje.
He received the mandate after Marina Pendeš resigned from her post as delegate.
Ipak, Čavara će ga najvjerovatnije odbiti.
However, Čavara will most likely refuse it.
Čavara i Pendeš su na izborima osvojili mandate u Predstavničkom domu, koji počinje raditi 1. decembra.
Čavara and Pendeš won mandates in the House of Representatives in the elections, which starts working on 1 December.
U Domu naroda Čavara ne bi dobijao platu i vjerovatno ne bi ni položio zakletvu.
In the House of Peoples Čavara would not receive a salary and probably would not even take the oath.
Zato se očekuje da oboje uđu u Predstavnički dom, a CIK će morati izabrati privremenu zamjenu za Pendeš.
That is why both are expected to enter the House of Representatives, and the CIK will have to choose a temporary replacement for Pendeš.
CIK je na sjednici donio i druge odluke o mandatima, između ostalog u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a i Skupštini Grada Banje Luke.
At the session the CIK also made other decisions on mandates, among others in the National Assembly of RS and the Banja Luka City Assembly.
U Banjoj Luci su ostavke dala četiri vijećnika, a njihova mjesta preuzimaju novi ljudi.
In Banja Luka four councillors resigned, and new people are taking their places.
Komisija je pokrenula i postupke protiv više od 70 stranaka zbog kršenja zakona o finansiranju stranaka.
The commission also started proceedings against more than 70 parties for breaking the law on the financing of parties.

title: Sindikat traži da minimalna plata zavisi od obrazovanja
Union asks for the minimum wage to depend on education
body: Savez samostalnih sindikata BiH poslao je hitnu inicijativu Vladi Federacije BiH.
The Association of Independent Trade Unions of BiH has sent an urgent initiative to the Government of the Federation of BiH.
Sindikat želi da se minimalna plata računa kao dio prosječne neto plate u Federaciji.
The union wants the minimum wage to be calculated as a share of the average net wage in the Federation.
Inicijativu je potpisao predsjednik sindikata Samir Kurtović, a dobili su je premijer Nermin Nikšić i ministar finansija Toni Kraljević.
The initiative was signed by union president Samir Kurtović, and it was received by Prime Minister Nermin Nikšić and Finance Minister Toni Kraljević.
Prema prijedlogu, radnik s osnovnom školom imao bi najmanje 80 posto prosječne plate.
According to the proposal, a worker with primary school would have at least 80 percent of the average wage.
Radnik sa srednjom školom imao bi 90 posto, a radnik s fakultetom 100 posto.
A worker with secondary school would have 90 percent, and a worker with a university degree 100 percent.
Sada se minimalna plata mijenja prema rastu cijena i ekonomije, ali sindikat kaže da je to pravilo zastarjelo.
Now the minimum wage changes according to the growth of prices and the economy, but the union says that rule is outdated.
Sindikat navodi da je dobit privrede u Federaciji 2025. godine bila 4,9 milijardi KM, a potrošačka korpa je ove godine poskupjela skoro 9 posto.
The union states that the profit of the economy in the Federation in 2025 was 4.9 billion KM, and the consumer basket has become almost 9 percent more expensive this year.
Inicijativa je poslana dan nakon sastanka Ekonomsko-socijalnog vijeća, koji je završio bez dogovora o povećanju minimalne plate.
The initiative was sent a day after a meeting of the Economic-Social Council, which ended without agreement on raising the minimum wage.
Ministar Kraljević ranije je rekao da će način računanja ostati isti.
Minister Kraljević said earlier that the method of calculation will stay the same.
Odluka o minimalnoj plati za sljedeću godinu mora se donijeti najkasnije do 31. decembra.
The decision on the minimum wage for next year must be made by 31 December at the latest.

title: SIPA uhapsila svoju inspektoricu zbog odavanja tajnih podataka
SIPA arrests its own inspector for leaking secret information
body: Državna agencija za istrage i zaštitu (SIPA) danas je provela akciju pod nazivom „Krug“.
The State Investigation and Protection Agency (SIPA) today carried out an operation called "Krug".
U akciji je uhapšena inspektorica SIPA-e Jelena Mičić, koja je osumnjičena za zloupotrebu položaja.
In the operation SIPA inspector Jelena Mičić was arrested, who is suspected of abuse of position.
Prema nezvaničnim informacijama, istraga obuhvata i njenog brata Stefana Šiljegovića.
According to unofficial information, the investigation also includes her brother Stefan Šiljegović.
Istraga je trajala nekoliko mjeseci, a počela je nakon podataka iz aplikacije SkyEcc.
The investigation lasted several months, and it started after data from the SkyEcc application.
Osumnjičena je, prema SIPA-i, s drugim osobama davala tajne informacije ljudima protiv kojih je SIPA vodila istrage.
According to SIPA, the suspect, together with other persons, gave secret information to people against whom SIPA was conducting investigations.
Tako su policijske akcije bile ugrožene.
In this way police operations were put at risk.
Pretresi se provode na četiri lokacije u Istočnom Sarajevu, ali i u službenim prostorijama SIPA-e.
Searches are being carried out at four locations in Istočno Sarajevo, but also in SIPA's official premises.
Policija je oduzela i mobilne telefone od dvije osobe, a stručnjaci će ih detaljno pregledati.
The police also seized mobile phones from two persons, and experts will examine them in detail.
Akcija se vodi pod nadzorom Tužilaštva BiH.
The operation is being conducted under the supervision of the Prosecutor's Office of BiH.
SIPA je saopćila da će nastaviti rad na slučaju i provjeriti da li su odgovorne i druge osobe.
SIPA announced that it will continue work on the case and check whether other persons are also responsible.

title: Vitamin C nije važno uzimati uz doručak
It does not matter whether you take vitamin C with breakfast
body: Stručnjaci s instituta Linus Pauling u SAD-u kažu da vitamin C ne morate uzimati uz obrok.
Experts from the Linus Pauling Institute in the USA say that you do not have to take vitamin C with a meal.
Tijelo ga jednako dobro prima i na prazan stomak, a važnija je količina koju uzimate.
The body absorbs it equally well on an empty stomach, and the amount you take is more important.
Alexander Michels, stručnjak za vitamin C, rekao je da kalcij može malo smanjiti upijanje, ali da se razlika vjerovatno neće primijetiti.
Alexander Michels, a vitamin C expert, said that calcium can slightly reduce absorption, but that the difference probably will not be noticed.
Nekim ljudima vitamin C izaziva probleme sa stomakom ili žgaravicu.
In some people vitamin C causes stomach problems or heartburn.
Oni mogu probati blaži oblik vitamina, koji manje smeta stomaku.
They can try a milder form of the vitamin, which bothers the stomach less.
Kada osoba uzima od 30 do 180 miligrama dnevno, tijelo upije 70 do 90 posto.
When a person takes from 30 to 180 milligrams a day, the body absorbs 70 to 90 percent.
Ako je doza veća od jednog grama, tijelo upije manje od pola, a ostatak izlazi urinom.
If the dose is larger than one gram, the body absorbs less than half, and the rest leaves through urine.
Michels savjetuje da se vitamin uzima dva puta dnevno, jer tako u krvi ostaje više vitamina.
Michels advises taking the vitamin twice a day, because that way more vitamin stays in the blood.
Muškarcima treba 90 miligrama dnevno, a ženama 75, dok pušačima treba 35 miligrama više.
Men need 90 milligrams a day and women 75, while smokers need 35 milligrams more.
Odrasli ne bi trebali uzimati više od 2.000 miligrama dnevno, jer to može izazvati proljev i mučninu.
Adults should not take more than 2,000 milligrams a day, because that can cause diarrhoea and nausea.

title: Naučnici: Glavobolja može biti povezana s probavom
Scientists: Headaches may be linked to digestion
body: Sve više istraživanja pokazuje da glavobolja nije uvijek problem samo u mozgu.
More and more research shows that a headache is not always a problem only in the brain.
Naučnici pronalaze vezu između migrene i probavnog sistema, posebno bakterija u crijevima.
Scientists are finding a link between migraine and the digestive system, especially bacteria in the gut.
Crijeva i mozak stalno razmjenjuju signale preko nerava, hormona i imunog sistema.
The gut and the brain constantly exchange signals through nerves, hormones and the immune system.
Pregled studija iz maja 2025. godine pokazao je da ljudi s migrenom često imaju drugačije bakterije u crijevima.
A review of studies from May 2025 showed that people with migraine often have different bacteria in the gut.
Velika britanska studija analizirala je podatke 489.753 osobe.
A large British study analysed data from 489,753 people.
Kod ljudi s migrenom šansa za sindrom iritabilnog crijeva bila je više nego dvostruko veća.
In people with migraine, the chance of irritable bowel syndrome was more than twice as high.
Ipak, to ne dokazuje da jedan problem direktno izaziva drugi.
However, this does not prove that one problem directly causes the other.
Naučnici još ispituju da li bolja probava može smanjiti broj migrena.
Scientists are still examining whether better digestion can reduce the number of migraines.
Zasad nema dovoljno dokaza da se migrena tako liječi.
So far there is not enough evidence to treat migraine that way.
Stručnjaci kažu da ljudi s čestim glavoboljama trebaju otkriti šta ih izaziva.
Experts say that people with frequent headaches should find out what causes them.
Ako je potrebno, trebali bi otići i kod neurologa i kod gastroenterologa.
If necessary, they should see both a neurologist and a gastroenterologist.

title: BiH večeras igra protiv Rumunije posljednju utakmicu godine
BiH plays Romania tonight in its last match of the year
body: Reprezentacija BiH večeras u 20:45 igra protiv Rumunije na Bilinom polju u Zenici.
The BiH national team plays Romania tonight at 20:45 at Bilino polje in Zenica.
To je posljednje kolo grupe B4 u Ligi nacija i posljednja utakmica ove godine.
It is the last round of group B4 in the Nations League and the last match of this year.
BiH je već osigurala drugo mjesto, pa će igrati baraž za ulazak u Ligu A.
BiH has already secured second place, so it will play a play-off for promotion to League A.
Protivnik u baražu bit će poznat nakon žrijeba u petak.
The play-off opponent will be known after the draw on Friday.
Napadač Haris Tabaković neće igrati, jer ove sedmice ide na operaciju meniskusa.
Striker Haris Tabaković will not play, because he is having meniscus surgery this week.
Tarik Muharemović se vratio nakon suspenzije, a Jovo Lukić normalno trenira nakon problema s leđima.
Tarik Muharemović is back after a suspension, and Jovo Lukić is training normally after back problems.
Rumunija je izgubila prve četiri utakmice, a u subotu je pobijedila Poljsku sa 2:1.
Romania lost its first four matches, and on Saturday it beat Poland 2:1.
BiH je pobijedila Rumuniju u posljednja tri susreta, a u septembru je slavila sa 4:2 u Bukureštu.
BiH beat Romania in their last three meetings, and in September it won 4:2 in Bucharest.
Selektor Sergej Barbarez rekao je da tim ozbiljno shvata ovu utakmicu.
Head coach Sergej Barbarez said that the team takes this match seriously.
On želi da godina završi pobjedom pred domaćim navijačima.
He wants the year to end with a win in front of the home fans.
Utakmicu sudi Španac Jose Maria Sanchez Martinez, a prenosit će je BHT i MY TV.
The match is refereed by Spaniard Jose Maria Sanchez Martinez, and BHT and MY TV will broadcast it.

title: Barbarez odabrao 23 igrača za utakmicu s Rumunijom
Barbarez picks 23 players for the match with Romania
body: Selektor Sergej Barbarez odabrao je 23 igrača za večerašnju utakmicu protiv Rumunije.
Head coach Sergej Barbarez has picked 23 players for tonight's match against Romania.
Utakmica šestog kola Lige nacija igra se u 20:45 na Bilinom polju u Zenici.
The sixth-round Nations League match is played at 20:45 at Bilino polje in Zenica.
U odnosu na utakmicu sa Švedskom, Barbarez je napravio dvije izmjene.
Compared with the match against Sweden, Barbarez made two changes.
Na spisku su sada Jovo Lukić i Tarik Muharemović.
Jovo Lukić and Tarik Muharemović are now on the list.
Ispali su Matej Deket i Haris Tabaković, koji mora na operaciju.
Matej Deket and Haris Tabaković, who needs surgery, have dropped out.
Dennis Hadžikadunić je povrijeđen i neće igrati nijednu utakmicu u novembru.
Dennis Hadžikadunić is injured and will not play any match in November.
Selektor ima 3 golmana, 8 odbrambenih igrača, 8 veznih igrača i 4 napadača.
The coach has 3 goalkeepers, 8 defenders, 8 midfielders and 4 strikers.
U petom kolu Švedska je u Solni pobijedila BiH sa 3:2.
In the fifth round, Sweden beat BiH 3:2 in Solna.
Golove za BiH dali su Armin Gigović i Sead Kolašinac.
The goals for BiH were scored by Armin Gigović and Sead Kolašinac.
Poljska je istog dana izgubila od Rumunije, zato je BiH osigurala baraž za Ligu A.
Poland lost to Romania on the same day, so BiH secured a play-off for League A.
Utakmicu prenose BHT i MY TV, a Klix.ba će pisati prenos uživo.
The match is broadcast by BHT and MY TV, and Klix.ba will run a live text commentary.

title: Iran objavio snimak obaranja američkog aviona F-15E
Iran releases footage of the downing of a US F-15E plane
body: Iranska državna televizija IRIB objavila je snimak za koji kaže da prikazuje obaranje američkog aviona.
Iranian state television IRIB released a video which it says shows the downing of an American plane.
Riječ je o borbenom avionu F-15E, koji je pao 3. aprila iznad jugozapadnog Irana.
It is an F-15E fighter jet, which went down on 3 April over south-western Iran.
Snimak je objavljen 16. novembra, oko 7 mjeseci nakon tog događaja.
The video was released on 16 November, about 7 months after that event.
Video traje oko 35 sekundi i snimljen je termalnom kamerom, koja snima toplotu.
The video lasts about 35 seconds and was filmed with a thermal camera, which records heat.
Na njemu se vidi kako avion pada uz trag dima, a zatim vatrena kugla na tlu.
It shows the plane falling with a trail of smoke, and then a fireball on the ground.
Na kraju se vide i dijelovi aviona na zemlji.
At the end, parts of the plane on the ground can also be seen.
Snimak je dio intervjua s vojnicima protivzračne odbrane koji kažu da su oborili avion.
The video is part of an interview with air defence soldiers who say they shot down the plane.
SAD su potvrdile da je avion oboren, a oba pilota su preživjela i spašena su.
The US confirmed that the plane was shot down, and both crew members survived and were rescued.
Predsjednik Donald Trump rekao je da je Iran koristio raketu koja se ispaljuje s ramena.
President Donald Trump said that Iran used a missile that is fired from the shoulder.
Na snimku se ne vidi kakvo oružje je pogodilo avion.
The video does not show what kind of weapon hit the plane.
Iranski mediji su ranije objavili fotografije dijelova aviona, ali ovo je prvi video obaranja.
Iranian media earlier published photos of parts of the plane, but this is the first video of the downing.

title: Srbija danas bira novog predsjednika Skupštine
Serbia elects a new speaker of parliament today
body: Nova Narodna skupština Srbije danas u 10:00 ima prvu sjednicu.
Serbia's new National Assembly holds its first session today at 10:00.
Poslanici će potvrditi mandate i izabrati predsjednika Skupštine i potpredsjednike.
The MPs will confirm their mandates and elect the speaker and the deputy speakers.
Novi predsjednik Skupštine postat će i vršilac dužnosti predsjednika Srbije.
The new speaker will also become acting president of Serbia.
Sjednicu je 8. novembra sazvala Ana Brnabić, koja je sada predsjednica Skupštine i vršilac dužnosti predsjednika države.
The session was called on 8 November by Ana Brnabić, who is now the speaker and acting head of state.
Ona ima tu ulogu otkako je Aleksandar Vučić podnio ostavku.
She has had this role since Aleksandar Vučić resigned.
Dok se ne izabere novi predsjednik, sjednicu vodi najstariji poslanik Stojan Radenović.
Until a new speaker is elected, the session is led by the oldest MP, Stojan Radenović.
Mediji kažu da su kandidati Studentske liste profesori Katarina Šćepanović i Aleksandar Čupić.
The media say that the Student List's candidates are professors Katarina Šćepanović and Aleksandar Čupić.
Prema ustavu, predsjednik Skupštine može zamijeniti predsjednika države najviše 3 mjeseca.
According to the constitution, the speaker can replace the head of state for at most 3 months.
U tom roku mora raspisati predsjedničke izbore.
Within that period, he or she must call presidential elections.
Studenti nisu dobili dozvolu da prisustvuju sjednici, zato su najavili okupljanje u parku kod Skupštine.
The students did not get permission to attend the session, so they announced a gathering in the park near the Assembly.

title: Novi senator El-Sayed oštro kritikovao Trumpa i Vancea
New senator El-Sayed sharply criticises Trump and Vance
body: Abdul El-Sayed, novi senator iz Michigana, oštro je kritikovao predsjednika SAD-a Donalda Trumpa.
Abdul El-Sayed, the new senator from Michigan, sharply criticised US President Donald Trump.
U intervjuu za emisiju novinara Mehdija Hasana nazvao ga je idiotom i narcisom.
In an interview for journalist Mehdi Hasan's show, he called him an idiot and a narcissist.
Intervju je objavljen 6. novembra, a 16. novembra se snimak proširio društvenim mrežama.
The interview was published on 6 November, and on 16 November the clip spread on social media.
El-Sayed je rekao da je potpredsjednik JD Vance gori od Trumpa, jer je zapravo pametan.
El-Sayed said that Vice President JD Vance is worse than Trump, because he is actually smart.
Prema njegovim riječima, Vance hvali Trumpa iako misli da je on budala.
According to him, Vance praises Trump even though he thinks he is a fool.
On smatra da Vance to radi da bi bio bliže vlasti.
He believes that Vance does this to be closer to power.
El-Sayed je rekao i da se 2028. godine neće kandidovati za predsjednika.
El-Sayed also said that he will not run for president in 2028.
El-Sayed je ljekar i epidemiolog, a izbore je dobio 3. novembra.
El-Sayed is a doctor and epidemiologist, and he won the election on 3 November.
Pobijedio je republikanca Mikea Rogersa i postao prvi musliman u američkom Senatu.
He defeated Republican Mike Rogers and became the first Muslim in the US Senate.
Dužnost preuzima u januaru 2027. godine, a zakletvu bi mu trebao dati upravo Vance.
He takes office in January 2027, and it is Vance who is expected to swear him in.

title: U budžetu američkog Senata pojavila se nova nuklearna bomba
A new nuclear bomb appears in the US Senate budget
body: U prijedlogu budžeta američkog Senata za 2027. godinu pojavila se nova nuklearna bomba B94.
A new nuclear bomb, the B94, has appeared in the US Senate's budget proposal for 2027.
Za nju je planirano 77,1 milion dolara, ali niko nije objasnio šta je to oružje.
77.1 million dollars has been planned for it, but nobody has explained what this weapon is.
To je prva nova oznaka za američku nuklearnu bombu od 1991. godine.
It is the first new designation for an American nuclear bomb since 1991.
Odbor Senata za budžet objavio je dokument 12. novembra.
The Senate budget committee published the document on 12 November.
U njemu nema opisa bombe, njene namjene ili plana za razvoj.
It contains no description of the bomb, its purpose or a development plan.
Stavku je prva primijetila stručnjakinja Eliana Johns iz Federacije američkih naučnika.
The item was first noticed by expert Eliana Johns from the Federation of American Scientists.
Slovo B znači bombu koja se baca iz aviona, a slovo W bojevu glavu za raketu.
The letter B means a bomb that is dropped from a plane, and the letter W a warhead for a missile.
Stručnjak Jeffrey Lewis sa Univerziteta Stanford rekao je da B94 liči na projekat NDS-A.
Expert Jeffrey Lewis from Stanford University said that the B94 looks like the NDS-A project.
Ta bomba bi trebala uništavati ciljeve koji su duboko pod zemljom.
That bomb would be meant to destroy targets that are deep underground.
Novac još nije odobren, jer prijedlog mora proći Senat i Predstavnički dom.
The money has not been approved yet, because the proposal must pass the Senate and the House of Representatives.

title: Matt Damon: Ben Affleck oduševljen Pattinsonom u filmu „The Odyssey“
Matt Damon: Ben Affleck thrilled with Pattinson in "The Odyssey"
body: Glumac Matt Damon rekao je da je Ben Affleck oduševljen ulogom Roberta Pattinsona u filmu „The Odyssey“.
Actor Matt Damon said that Ben Affleck is thrilled with Robert Pattinson's role in the film "The Odyssey".
Film je režirao Christopher Nolan, a Damon igra glavnu ulogu.
The film was directed by Christopher Nolan, and Damon plays the lead role.
Damon je o tome govorio za magazin People.
Damon talked about this to People magazine.
Affleck je pogledao film i nakon toga je Damona zvao telefonom oko 45 minuta.
Affleck watched the film and afterwards called Damon on the phone for about 45 minutes.
Prema Damonovim riječima, oko 20 minuta je pričao samo o Pattinsonu.
According to Damon, he talked only about Pattinson for about 20 minutes.
Pattinson igra Antinoja, vođu muškaraca koji žele oženiti Penelopu dok Odisej nije kod kuće.
Pattinson plays Antinous, the leader of the men who want to marry Penelope while Odysseus is away from home.
Damon je rekao da je Pattinson zanimljiv i hrabar glumac i da je fantastičan.
Damon said that Pattinson is an interesting and fearless actor and that he is fantastic.
Film je nastao prema Homerovom epu i prati Odisejev put kući nakon Trojanskog rata.
The film is based on Homer's epic and follows Odysseus's journey home after the Trojan War.
U filmu igraju i Anne Hathaway kao Penelopa i Tom Holland kao njihov sin.
Anne Hathaway as Penelope and Tom Holland as their son also appear in the film.
Pattinson je u ponedjeljak predstavljen kao novi James Bond, a uskoro igra i u filmu „Dune: Part Three“.
Pattinson was presented as the new James Bond on Monday, and he will soon also appear in "Dune: Part Three".

title: Zmajevi odradili posljednji trening pred utakmicu s Rumunijom
The Dragons hold their last training session before the match with Romania
body: Reprezentacija BiH u ponedjeljak je imala posljednji trening pred utakmicu s Rumunijom.
The BiH national team had its last training session on Monday before the match with Romania.
Trening je bio na stadionu Asim Ferhatović Hase u Sarajevu, a atmosfera je bila odlična.
The training was at the Asim Ferhatović Hase stadium in Sarajevo, and the atmosphere was excellent.
Utakmica Lige nacija igra se u utorak u 20:45 na Bilinom polju u Zenici.
The Nations League match is played on Tuesday at 20:45 at Bilino polje in Zenica.
BiH je već osigurala drugo mjesto u grupi i igrat će baraž za Ligu A.
BiH has already secured second place in the group and will play a play-off for League A.
Napadač Haris Tabaković neće igrati, jer ima povredu meniskusa i ove sedmice ide na operaciju.
Striker Haris Tabaković will not play, because he has a meniscus injury and is having surgery this week.
Selektor Sergej Barbarez očekuje da se vrati u martu.
Head coach Sergej Barbarez expects him to return in March.
Tarik Muharemović i Jovo Lukić ponovo su spremni za igru.
Tarik Muharemović and Jovo Lukić are ready to play again.
Osam igrača ima po jedan žuti karton manje do suspenzije, ali Barbarez kaže da to neće utjecati na tim.
Eight players are each one yellow card away from a suspension, but Barbarez says this will not affect the team.
Rumunija je izgubila prve četiri utakmice, a u subotu je pobijedila Poljsku sa 2:1.
Romania lost its first four matches, and on Saturday it beat Poland 2:1.
BiH je pobijedila Rumuniju u posljednja tri susreta, a utakmicu će prenositi BHT i MY TV.
BiH beat Romania in the last three meetings, and the match will be broadcast by BHT and MY TV.

title: Le Pen: Ako pobijedim, Francuska neće davati novac Kijevu
Le Pen: If I win, France will not give money to Kyiv
body: Marine Le Pen u ponedjeljak se u Parizu sastala s ambasadorom Ukrajine u Francuskoj.
Marine Le Pen met Ukraine's ambassador to France in Paris on Monday.
Rekla mu je da Francuska neće moći davati novac Ukrajini ako ona pobijedi na izborima.
She told him that France will not be able to give money to Ukraine if she wins the election.
Le Pen je kandidatkinja stranke Nacionalno okupljanje za predsjednicu Francuske.
Le Pen is the National Rally party's candidate for president of France.
Prema njenim riječima, francuske javne finansije to više ne bi dozvolile.
According to her words, French public finances would no longer allow it.
Ipak, Francuska bi poštovala stare obaveze, kao što je kredit EU od 90 milijardi eura za Ukrajinu.
Still, France would respect old commitments, such as the EU loan of 90 billion euros for Ukraine.
Taj kredit treba pokriti potrebe Ukrajine za 2026. i 2027. godinu.
That loan is meant to cover Ukraine's needs for 2026 and 2027.
Le Pen procjenjuje da Francuska godišnje daje Ukrajini oko 6 milijardi eura.
Le Pen estimates that France gives Ukraine about 6 billion euros a year.
Rekla je da bi materijalna i humanitarna pomoć ipak ostala.
She said that material and humanitarian aid would still remain.
Predsjednik Emmanuel Macron u subotu je kritikovao one koji žele smanjiti pomoć Ukrajini.
President Emmanuel Macron on Saturday criticised those who want to reduce aid to Ukraine.
Le Pen vodi u anketama pred predsjedničke izbore, koji će biti na proljeće 2027. godine.
Le Pen leads in polls ahead of the presidential election, which will be in spring 2027.

title: Dodik: Nema žurbe s formiranjem vlasti na državnom nivou
Dodik: No hurry with forming the government at state level
body: Predsjednik SNSD-a Milorad Dodik u ponedjeljak je govorio o formiranju vlasti na nivou BiH.
SNSD president Milorad Dodik spoke on Monday about forming the government at the BiH level.
Oglasio se nakon konstituirajuće sjednice Narodne skupštine Republike Srpske.
He spoke up after the constituent session of the National Assembly of Republika Srpska.
Na društvenim mrežama napisao je da nema žurbe ni bilo kakvih pritisaka.
On social media he wrote that there is no hurry and no pressure of any kind.
Dodik je rekao da RS neće prihvatiti rješenja koja su na njenu štetu.
Dodik said that RS will not accept solutions that are to its detriment.
SNSD i partneri će, kako je naveo, štititi interese RS-a u svim budućim procesima.
SNSD and its partners will, as he stated, protect the interests of RS in all future processes.
On traži da se preispitaju sve ranije odluke visokog predstavnika.
He wants all earlier decisions of the High Representative to be reviewed.
Također traži da se ponište odluke koje je nametnuo Christian Schmidt, jer smatra da on nema legitimitet.
He also wants the decisions imposed by Christian Schmidt to be annulled, because he believes Schmidt has no legitimacy.
Dodik želi i novu platformu za buduće odnose u BiH.
Dodik also wants a new platform for future relations in BiH.
Rekao je da SNSD neće zloupotrijebiti svoju političku snagu na državnom nivou.
He said that SNSD will not misuse its political strength at the state level.
Prema njegovim riječima, tu snagu će koristiti samo da ojača ustavni položaj RS-a.
According to his words, it will use that strength only to strengthen the constitutional position of RS.

title: Snijeg prekrio Kineski zid kod Pekinga
Snow covers the Great Wall of China near Beijing
body: Snijeg je u ponedjeljak ujutro prekrio dio Kineskog zida koji se zove Badaling.
On Monday morning snow covered the part of the Great Wall of China called Badaling.
Badaling je oko 60 kilometara sjeverozapadno od centra Pekinga.
Badaling is about 60 kilometres north-west of the centre of Beijing.
Ovo je drugi snijeg na tom dijelu zida ove jeseni, a stiglo je mnogo posjetilaca.
This is the second snow on that part of the wall this autumn, and many visitors came.
Ljudi su fotografisali zid i šetali po snijegu, a neki su ga gledali iz žičare.
People photographed the wall and walked in the snow, and some watched it from the cable car.
Kompanija koja upravlja lokacijom tokom noći je očistila snijeg i led.
The company that manages the site cleared the snow and ice during the night.
Na strme dijelove radnici su stavili vreće s pijeskom i užad za sigurnost.
On the steep parts workers put sandbags and safety ropes.
Agencija Xinhua već je 8. novembra objavila fotografije snijega na ovom dijelu zida.
The Xinhua agency had already published photos of snow on this part of the wall on 8 November.
Badaling je najbolje očuvan dio zida iz vremena dinastije Ming.
Badaling is the best-preserved part of the wall from the time of the Ming dynasty.
Za posjetioce je otvoren 1958. godine, a danas je otvoreno 3.741 metar zida.
It was opened to visitors in 1958, and today 3,741 metres of the wall are open.
Zid je od 1987. godine na UNESCO-voj listi svjetske baštine.
Since 1987 the wall has been on UNESCO's World Heritage list.

title: Engleska i Sjeverna Makedonija najvjerovatniji rivali BiH za Euro 2028
England and North Macedonia the most likely BiH rivals for Euro 2028
body: Statistički portal Football Meets Data napravio je simulaciju žrijeba za kvalifikacije za Euro 2028.
The statistics portal Football Meets Data made a simulation of the draw for the Euro 2028 qualifiers.
Prema rezultatima, Engleska i Sjeverna Makedonija su najvjerovatniji rivali BiH.
According to the results, England and North Macedonia are the most likely rivals of BiH.
Pravi žrijeb bit će 6. decembra u Belfastu.
The real draw will be on 6 December in Belfast.
Portal je napravio 50.000 simulacija, jer konačan sastav šešira još nije poznat.
The portal ran 50,000 simulations, because the final make-up of the pots is not yet known.
BiH je u drugom šeširu, a iz prvog šešira Engleska ima 18 posto šanse.
BiH is in the second pot, and from the first pot England has an 18 percent chance.
Slijede Italija sa 14 i Španija sa 10 posto.
Italy follows with 14 and Spain with 10 percent.
Iz trećeg šešira Sjeverna Makedonija ima 14 posto, a Rumunija i Izrael po 13 posto.
From the third pot North Macedonia has 14 percent, and Romania and Israel 13 percent each.
BiH ima 77 posto šanse da bude u grupi s četiri ekipe.
BiH has a 77 percent chance of being in a group with four teams.
Najvjerovatniji rivali su ekipe koje u martu 2027. igraju utakmice Lige nacija.
The most likely rivals are teams that play Nations League matches in March 2027.
Bit će 12 grupa sa četiri ili pet ekipa.
There will be 12 groups with four or five teams.
Kvalifikacije će trajati do novembra 2027. godine.
The qualifiers will last until November 2027.

title: Osmani: Žaljenje Brisela zbog srpske pjesme nije dovoljno
Osmani: Brussels' regret over the Serbian song is not enough
body: Bivša predsjednica Kosova Vjosa Osmani kritikovala je Evropsku komisiju zbog jedne pjesme.
Former Kosovo president Vjosa Osmani criticised the European Commission because of a song.
Na otvaranju Foruma o proširenju EU u nedjelju navečer svirala se srpska pjesma "Sa Kosova zora sviće".
At the opening of the EU Enlargement Forum on Sunday evening the Serbian song "Sa Kosova zora sviće" was played.
Pjesma je izvedena bez riječi, ali mnogi na Kosovu smatraju da negira suverenitet Kosova.
The song was performed without words, but many in Kosovo believe it denies Kosovo's sovereignty.
Evropska komesarka Marta Kos u ponedjeljak je rekla da žali zbog izbora pjesme.
European Commissioner Marta Kos said on Monday that she regrets the choice of song.
Dodala je da pjesma nikako ne pokazuje stavove Evropske komisije.
She added that the song in no way reflects the views of the European Commission.
Osmani je na mreži X napisala da to žaljenje nije dovoljno.
Osmani wrote on the network X that this regret is not enough.
Pitala je ko je izabrao pjesmu, ko ju je odobrio i ko je odgovoran.
She asked who chose the song, who approved it and who is responsible.
I drugi političari s Kosova rekli su da je izvedba skandalozna i neprihvatljiva.
Other politicians from Kosovo also said the performance was scandalous and unacceptable.
Pjesmu je napisao Ljubomir Manasijević 1989. godine, za 600 godina od Kosovske bitke.
The song was written by Ljubomir Manasijević in 1989, for 600 years since the Battle of Kosovo.
Postala je popularnija nakon 2008. godine, kada je Kosovo proglasilo nezavisnost.
It became more popular after 2008, when Kosovo declared independence.

title: Preuzimanja igre GTA VI srušila rekord interneta u Frankfurtu
GTA VI downloads break an internet record in Frankfurt
body: Preuzimanja igre GTA VI srušila su rekord u DE-CIX-u u Frankfurtu, najvećem internet čvorištu u Evropi.
Downloads of the game GTA VI broke a record at DE-CIX in Frankfurt, the largest internet hub in Europe.
Čvorište je mjesto gdje se povezuju mreže mnogih internet kompanija.
A hub is a place where the networks of many internet companies connect.
Igrači koji su unaprijed kupili igru mogu je preuzimati od 10. novembra.
Players who bought the game in advance have been able to download it since 10 November.
Promet je dostigao rekordnih 22,3 terabita u sekundi, što je 19% više nego prije.
Traffic reached a record 22.3 terabits per second, which is 19% more than before.
Samo igra GTA VI činila je 4 terabita u sekundi, javila je agencija Reuters.
The game GTA VI alone made up 4 terabits per second, the Reuters agency reported.
U svim čvorištima DE-CIX-a u svijetu promet je dostigao novi rekord od 33 terabita.
In all DE-CIX hubs around the world, traffic reached a new record of 33 terabits.
Igra službeno izlazi u četvrtak, 19. novembra.
The game is officially released on Thursday, 19 November.
Tehnički direktor Thomas King rekao je da je teško reći hoće li tada pasti novi rekord.
Technical director Thomas King said that it is hard to say whether a new record will fall then.
Reuters procjenjuje da bi kompanija Take-Two mogla zaraditi 5,2 milijarde dolara u prvoj sedmici.
Reuters estimates that the company Take-Two could earn 5.2 billion dollars in the first week.
Prethodna igra GTA V izašla je 2013. godine i prodata je u 230 miliona primjeraka.
The previous game, GTA V, came out in 2013 and has sold 230 million copies.

title: Novo Predsjedništvo BiH preuzelo dužnost, prvi put dvije žene
New BiH Presidency takes office, two women for the first time
body: Denis Bećirović, Željka Cvijanović i Darijana Filipović u ponedjeljak su preuzeli dužnost članova Predsjedništva BiH.
Denis Bećirović, Željka Cvijanović and Darijana Filipović took office as members of the BiH Presidency on Monday.
Svečana sjednica održana je u zgradi Predsjedništva u Sarajevu.
The ceremonial session was held in the Presidency building in Sarajevo.
Ovo je deveti saziv Predsjedništva i prvi put u njemu sjede dvije žene.
This is the ninth composition of the Presidency and for the first time two women sit in it.
Predsjednik CIK-a Jovan Kalaba predao im je mandate, a oni su potpisali svečanu izjavu.
The president of the Central Election Commission, Jovan Kalaba, handed them their mandates, and they signed a solemn declaration.
Na izborima 4. oktobra Cvijanović je dobila 319.705 glasova, Bećirović 222.484, a Filipović 120.701.
In the elections on 4 October Cvijanović won 319,705 votes, Bećirović 222,484 and Filipović 120,701.
Bećirović i Cvijanović počinju drugi mandat zaredom, a mandat traje do 2030. godine.
Bećirović and Cvijanović are starting a second term in a row, and the term lasts until 2030.
Filipović je potpredsjednica HDZ-a BiH i dolazi umjesto Željka Komšića, koji je bio član četiri mandata.
Filipović is vice-president of HDZ BiH and replaces Željko Komšić, who was a member for four terms.
Cvijanović je rekla da su se dogovorili o rotaciji i o tome ko će predsjedavati.
Cvijanović said they had agreed on the rotation and on who will chair.
Filipović je rekla da se trojica članova neće slagati o mnogo pitanja, ali da je to demokratija.
Filipović said the three members will not agree on many questions, but that this is democracy.
Bećirović je kao prioritete naveo ljudska prava, suverenitet BiH te put prema EU i NATO-u.
Bećirović named human rights, the sovereignty of BiH and the path towards the EU and NATO as priorities.

title: Robert Pattinson je novi James Bond
Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
body: Britanski glumac Robert Pattinson izabran je za novog Jamesa Bonda.
British actor Robert Pattinson has been chosen as the new James Bond.
Vijest je objavio magazin Variety, a objavljena je i prva fotografija.
The news was published by the magazine Variety, and the first photo has also been published.
Tako je završena potraga kompanije Amazon MGM za nasljednikom Daniela Craiga.
This ended the search by the company Amazon MGM for Daniel Craig's successor.
Craig je glumio Bonda u pet filmova, od "Casino Royale" 2006. do "No Time to Die" 2021. godine.
Craig played Bond in five films, from "Casino Royale" in 2006 to "No Time to Die" in 2021.
Za ulogu su se spominjali i Jacob Elordi, Callum Turner, Nicholas Hoult i Harry Styles.
Jacob Elordi, Callum Turner, Nicholas Hoult and Harry Styles were also mentioned for the role.
Pattinson ove godine ima veliki uspjeh, a film "The Drama" zaradio je 134 miliona dolara.
Pattinson is having great success this year, and the film "The Drama" earned 134 million dollars.
U decembru izlazi i film "Dune: Part Three", u kojem također glumi.
In December the film "Dune: Part Three", in which he also acts, comes out as well.
Novi film o Bondu režirat će Denis Villeneuve.
The new Bond film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve.
On je ranije rekao da je veliki fan Bonda.
He said earlier that he is a big Bond fan.
Pattinson glumi i Batmana, a nastavak tog filma očekuje se 2028. godine.
Pattinson also plays Batman, and the sequel to that film is expected in 2028.

title: Stanivuković podnio krivične prijave zbog kupovine poslanika
Stanivuković filed criminal complaints over the buying of MPs
body: Gradonačelnik Banje Luke Draško Stanivuković danas je predao krivične prijave Republičkom javnom tužilaštvu RS-a.
Banja Luka mayor Draško Stanivuković today submitted criminal complaints to the Republic Public Prosecutor's Office of RS.
On je i predsjednik stranke Pokret Sigurna Srpska, poznate kao PSS.
He is also the president of the Pokret Sigurna Srpska party, known as PSS.
Stanivuković tvrdi da se u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a kupuju poslanici.
Stanivuković claims that MPs are being bought in the National Assembly of RS.
Prema njegovim riječima, nekim poslanicima su nudili funkcije, posao i novac ako pređu u vladajuću većinu.
According to him, some MPs were offered positions, jobs and money if they moved to the ruling majority.
Vladimir Ćopić izabran je na listi SDS-a, a zatim je prešao u Ujedinjenu Srpsku.
Vladimir Ćopić was elected on the SDS list, and then he moved to Ujedinjena Srpska.
Stanivuković kaže da je Ćopiću ponuđeno mjesto direktora bolnice u Prijedoru.
Stanivuković says that Ćopić was offered the post of director of the hospital in Prijedor.
Snježana Gvozden napustila je PSS i prešla u SNSD, a nakon toga je postala potpredsjednica skupštine.
Snježana Gvozden left PSS and moved to SNSD, and after that she became vice-president of the assembly.
Stanivuković je rekao da je to izdaja birača i spomenuo njenu platu od više od 5.000 KM.
Stanivuković said that this is a betrayal of the voters and mentioned her salary of more than 5,000 KM.
PSS želi promijeniti Izborni zakon BiH, tako da mandat pripada stranci, a ne poslaniku.
PSS wants to change the Election Law of BiH so that the mandate belongs to the party, not to the MP.
Prijave dolaze u vrijeme kada se nakon izbora formira nova većina u skupštini.
The complaints come at a time when a new majority is being formed in the assembly after the elections.
Da li je bilo krivičnih djela, odlučit će pravosudne institucije.
Whether there were any criminal offences will be decided by the judicial institutions.

title: Palestinac Ahmed Tibi izabran za potpredsjednika Knesseta
Palestinian Ahmed Tibi elected deputy speaker of the Knesset
body: Ahmed Tibi, lider stranke Ta'al, danas je izabran za potpredsjednika izraelskog parlamenta, Knesseta.
Ahmed Tibi, leader of the Ta'al party, was today elected deputy speaker of the Israeli parliament, the Knesset.
On je rekao da je to pobjeda nad krajnjom desnicom u Izraelu.
He said that this is a victory over the far right in Israel.
Prema njegovim riječima, Likud i ministar Itamar Ben-Gvir pokušali su spriječiti izbor, ali nisu uspjeli.
According to him, Likud and minister Itamar Ben-Gvir tried to prevent the election, but they did not succeed.
Tibi je rođen 1958. godine u gradu Taibe, a po zanimanju je ljekar.
Tibi was born in 1958 in the town of Taibe, and he is a doctor by profession.
Od 1993. do 1999. bio je politički savjetnik palestinskog lidera Jasera Arafata.
From 1993 to 1999 he was a political adviser to the Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
Stranku Ta'al osnovao je 1996. godine, a u Knesset je prvi put ušao 1999.
He founded the Ta'al party in 1996, and he first entered the Knesset in 1999.
Tibi podržava rješenje s dvije države i pravo palestinskih izbjeglica na povratak.
Tibi supports the two-state solution and the right of Palestinian refugees to return.
Za sebe kaže da je arapski Palestinac s izraelskim državljanstvom.
He says of himself that he is an Arab Palestinian with Israeli citizenship.
Godine 2000. slomljena mu je ruka dok se suprotstavio Arielu Sharonu kod džamije Al-Aqsa.
In 2000 his arm was broken while he confronted Ariel Sharon near the Al-Aqsa mosque.
U Knessetu je 2016. godine proučio ezan, poziv na molitvu, kao protest protiv jednog zakona.
In the Knesset in 2016 he recited the adhan, the call to prayer, as a protest against a law.

title: Cvijanović položila zakletvu u Banjoj Luci i hvalila Dodika
Cvijanović took an oath in Banja Luka and praised Dodik
body: Članica Predsjedništva BiH Željka Cvijanović danas je položila zakletvu u Narodnoj skupštini RS-a.
Member of the BiH Presidency Željka Cvijanović today took an oath in the National Assembly of RS.
Ta zakletva nema pravnu snagu, jer Ustav BiH ne daje entitetskim skupštinama ulogu u tome.
That oath has no legal force, because the Constitution of BiH gives entity assemblies no role in it.
Cvijanović dužnost preuzima tek u 16 sati, na sjednici Predsjedništva u Sarajevu.
Cvijanović takes up her duty only at 16:00, at the session of the Presidency in Sarajevo.
Ovu ceremoniju uveo je Milorad Dodik nakon izbora 2018. godine, a Cvijanović ju je ponovila i 2022.
This ceremony was introduced by Milorad Dodik after the 2018 elections, and Cvijanović repeated it in 2022 as well.
U govoru je rekla da će ponovo koristiti ustavni mehanizam za zaštitu vitalnih interesa RS-a.
In her speech she said that she will again use the constitutional mechanism to protect the vital interests of RS.
Za to joj treba podrška skupštine, ali se nada da će takvi mehanizmi biti manje potrebni.
For that she needs the support of the assembly, but she hopes such mechanisms will be needed less.
Cvijanović je pozdravila „predsjednika Dodika“, iako on više nije predsjednik RS-a.
Cvijanović greeted "President Dodik", although he is no longer president of RS.
Zahvalila mu je što je cijeli taj period, kako je rekla, izdržao stoički, odnosno mirno i bez žalbe.
She thanked him for enduring that whole period, as she said, stoically, that is calmly and without complaint.
Pozvala je i da se nova vlada RS-a izabere što prije.
She also called for the new RS government to be elected as soon as possible.

title: Visok krvni pritisak može biti znak bolesti bubrega
High blood pressure can be a sign of kidney disease
body: Visok krvni pritisak može biti jedan od prvih znakova bolesti bubrega.
High blood pressure can be one of the first signs of kidney disease.
Bolest bubrega na početku obično nema simptome, pa se često otkrije slučajno.
Kidney disease usually has no symptoms at the start, so it is often discovered by chance.
To pišu američke i britanske zdravstvene institucije, među njima i NHS.
This is written by American and British health institutions, among them the NHS.
Visok pritisak polako oštećuje male krvne sudove u bubrezima, koji čiste krv.
High pressure slowly damages the small blood vessels in the kidneys, which clean the blood.
Oštećeni bubrezi teže izbacuju višak soli i vode, pa pritisak još više raste.
Damaged kidneys have more trouble removing excess salt and water, so the pressure rises even more.
Visok pritisak je drugi najčešći uzrok hronične bolesti bubrega.
High pressure is the second most common cause of chronic kidney disease.
Skoro jedna od pet odraslih osoba s visokim pritiskom ima i bolest bubrega.
Almost one in five adults with high pressure also has kidney disease.
Kasnije se mogu javiti umor, otečeni gležnjevi, mučnina i često mokrenje noću.
Later, tiredness, swollen ankles, nausea and frequent urination at night can appear.
Stručnjaci savjetuju da s ljekarom razgovarate o jednostavnim testovima krvi i urina.
Experts advise that you talk to a doctor about simple blood and urine tests.
Ljudi s visokim pritiskom ili dijabetesom trebali bi redovno ići na kontrole.
People with high pressure or diabetes should go for regular check-ups.
Najbolji način da se bubrezi zaštite je spuštanje pritiska, a pomažu i lijekovi.
The best way to protect the kidneys is lowering the pressure, and medicines also help.

title: Savo Minić u skupštini Dodika nazvao predsjednikom RS-a
Savo Minić called Dodik president of RS in the assembly
body: Novi predsjednik Republike Srpske Savo Minić danas je govorio na konstituirajućoj sjednici Narodne skupštine RS-a.
The new President of Republika Srpska, Savo Minić, spoke today at the constituent session of the National Assembly of RS.
Govor je počeo riječima: „Poštovani predsjedniče Republike Srpske, predsjedniče Dodik.“
He began the speech with the words: "Honourable President of Republika Srpska, President Dodik."
To je privuklo pažnju, jer Milorad Dodik više od godinu dana nema tu funkciju.
That drew attention, because Milorad Dodik has not held that office for more than a year.
Minić je zatim predstavio svoj program za naredni mandat.
Minić then presented his programme for the next term.
Rekao je da će uskoro početi formiranje nove vlade.
He said that the formation of the new government will begin soon.
On je kandidat SNSD-a i pobijedio je na općim izborima 4. oktobra.
He is the SNSD candidate and he won the general elections on 4 October.
Sud BiH osudio je Dodika na godinu zatvora i šest godina zabrane obavljanja funkcije predsjednika RS-a.
The Court of BiH sentenced Dodik to a year in prison and a six-year ban on holding the office of RS president.
Kaznu zatvora kasnije je zamijenila novčana kazna.
The prison sentence was later replaced by a fine.
Centralna izborna komisija oduzela mu je mandat u augustu 2025. godine.
The Central Election Commission took away his mandate in August 2025.
Dodik te odluke nije prihvatio, a danas je predsjednik SNSD-a.
Dodik did not accept those decisions, and today he is the president of SNSD.

title: Srbija mogući rival BiH u baražu zbog pravila o Kosovu
Serbia a possible BiH rival in the play-off because of the Kosovo rule
body: Reprezentacija BiH igrat će baraž za ulazak u Diviziju A Lige nacija.
The BiH national team will play a play-off for entry into Division A of the Nations League.
Žrijeb je u petak, 20. novembra, u 12 sati u švicarskom gradu Nyonu.
The draw is on Friday, 20 November, at 12:00 in the Swiss town of Nyon.
Zbog jednog pravila UEFA-e, Srbija bi mogla biti najvjerovatniji protivnik BiH.
Because of one UEFA rule, Serbia could be the most likely opponent of BiH.
UEFA je odlučila da Kosovo ne može igrati protiv Srbije ni protiv BiH.
UEFA decided that Kosovo cannot play against Serbia or against BiH.
Ako Kosovo uđe u baraž, Srbija bi imala samo tri moguća rivala, a jedan od njih je BiH.
If Kosovo enters the play-off, Serbia would have only three possible rivals, and one of them is BiH.
Tada bi šansa za susret BiH i Srbije bila 33,3 posto.
Then the chance of a BiH–Serbia meeting would be 33.3 percent.
Portal Football Meets Data trenutno daje 28 posto šanse za taj par.
The portal Football Meets Data currently gives a 28 percent chance for that pairing.
Srbija večeras u 20:45 igra protiv Grčke u Volosu i ne smije izgubiti visoko.
Serbia plays against Greece tonight at 20:45 in Volos and must not lose heavily.
Kosovo u utorak igra u Irskoj, a za baraž mu je dovoljan i neriješen rezultat.
Kosovo plays in Ireland on Tuesday, and a draw is enough for it to reach the play-off.
Utakmice baraža igraju se od 25. do 30. marta 2027. godine.
The play-off matches are played from 25 to 30 March 2027.
BiH će prvu utakmicu igrati kod kuće.
BiH will play the first match at home.

title: Sarajevo dobija novi festival dokumentarnog filma
Sarajevo is getting a new documentary film festival
body: U Sarajevu je danas predstavljen program prvog WITNESS festivala.
The programme of the first WITNESS festival was presented in Sarajevo today.
Festival će se održati od 24. do 28. novembra, a organizuju ga Sarajevo Film Festival i fondacija WARM.
The festival will be held from 24 to 28 November, and it is organised by the Sarajevo Film Festival and the WARM foundation.
Filmovi će se prikazivati na četiri mjesta, a glavna kuća festivala je kino Meeting Point.
The films will be shown at four venues, and the main house of the festival is the Meeting Point cinema.
Festival otvara film Sophie Fiennes, a rediteljka će doći u Sarajevo.
The festival opens with a film by Sophie Fiennes, and the director will come to Sarajevo.
Zatvara ga film Marka Cousinsa o dokumentarnom filmu devedesetih godina.
It closes with Mark Cousins's film about the documentary film of the nineties.
U programu je i film „Godina poslije Dejtona“ o prvoj godini mira u BiH.
The programme also includes the film "A Year After Dayton" about the first year of peace in BiH.
Ulaznice koštaju 15 KM u kinu Meeting Point i 10 KM u drugim kinima.
Tickets cost 15 KM at the Meeting Point cinema and 10 KM in the other cinemas.
Online prodaja počela je danas u 12 sati, a blagajne se otvaraju 24. novembra.
Online sales began today at 12:00, and the box offices open on 24 November.
Izložbe i jutarnji razgovori bit će besplatni.
The exhibitions and morning talks will be free.
Organizatori su rekli da je ideja nastala iz pitanja šta bismo pitali svjedoka nakon filma.
The organisers said that the idea came from the question of what we would ask a witness after a film.

title: Roboti s umjetnim mišićima sviraju klavir i pomjeraju oči
Robots with artificial muscles play the piano and move their eyes
body: Inženjeri s Univerziteta u Pennsylvaniji razvili su nove umjetne mišiće za robote.
Engineers from the University of Pennsylvania have developed new artificial muscles for robots.
Pokazali su ih na robotskim prstima koji sviraju klavir i na očima koje gledaju kao ljudske.
They showed them on robotic fingers that play the piano and on eyes that look like human ones.
Mišići su tanka vlakna koja se mogu pomjeriti u željeni položaj i ostati u njemu.
The muscles are thin fibres that can move into a desired position and stay in it.
Vlakna su napravljena od posebnog materijala koji mijenja oblik kada se zagrije.
The fibres are made of a special material that changes shape when it is heated.
U njima je i tanka bakarna žica, koja grije materijal i istovremeno mjeri njegov položaj.
Inside them there is also a thin copper wire, which heats the material and at the same time measures its position.
Zato robotu ne treba poseban senzor, a grafen čini materijal mekšim i jačim.
That is why the robot does not need a separate sensor, and graphene makes the material softer and stronger.
Mišići rade u parovima, slično kao mišići u ljudskom tijelu.
The muscles work in pairs, similar to the muscles in the human body.
Profesorica Cynthia Sung rekla je da je ovo prvi put da je takvo upravljanje pokazano na ovom materijalu.
Professor Cynthia Sung said that this is the first time such control has been shown on this material.
Istraživači misle da bi se mišići mogli koristiti za lica humanoidnih robota.
The researchers think the muscles could be used for the faces of humanoid robots.
Za prirodan izraz lica potrebno je mnogo malih mišića koji rade zajedno.
A natural facial expression requires many small muscles working together.
Tim sada planira koristiti umjetnu inteligenciju za složenije pokrete.
The team now plans to use artificial intelligence for more complex movements.

title: Muharemović se vraća i želi Vels u baražu
Muharemović returns and wants Wales in the play-off
body: Tarik Muharemović, štoper reprezentacije BiH i Leedsa, vraća se u tim za utakmicu protiv Rumunije.
Tarik Muharemović, a centre-back for the BiH national team and Leeds, returns to the team for the match against Romania.
