Utakmica Lige nacija igra se u utorak u Zenici od 20:45.
The Nations League match is played on Tuesday in Zenica from 20:45.
Protiv Švedske nije mogao igrati jer je imao previše žutih kartona.
He could not play against Sweden because he had too many yellow cards.
Muharemović je za Klix.ba rekao da mu je bilo teško gledati utakmicu s tribina.
Muharemović told Klix.ba that it was hard for him to watch the match from the stands.
Posebno mu se dopalo drugo poluvrijeme, kada su se igrači borili za svaku loptu.
He especially liked the second half, when the players fought for every ball.
Rumuniju smatra vrlo jakim timom, a BiH je s njom često igrala u posljednje dvije godine.
He considers Romania a very strong team, and BiH has often played against it in the last two years.
On misli da će Rumuni htjeti revanš za ranije rezultate.
He thinks the Romanians will want revenge for earlier results.
BiH će u baražu igrati za plasman u Diviziju A Lige nacija.
BiH will play in the play-off for promotion to Division A of the Nations League.
Muharemović se nada da će protivnik biti Vels.
Muharemović hopes that the opponent will be Wales.
Rekao je da to žele i njegovi saigrači iz Velsa u Leedsu, jer traže revanš.
He said that his teammates from Wales at Leeds want this too, because they are looking for revenge.
Utakmicu s Rumunijom uživo prenose BHT i MY TV.
The match with Romania is broadcast live by BHT and MY TV.

title: Dvije sedmice juga i kiše, krajem mjeseca moguć snijeg
Two weeks of jugo and rain, snow possible at the end of the month
body: Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod objavio je prognozu vremena od 17. do 30. novembra.
The Federal Hydrometeorological Institute has published a weather forecast from 17 to 30 November.
U Bosni i Hercegovini u narednim danima bit će oblačno, s kišom i pljuskovima.
In Bosnia and Herzegovina in the coming days it will be cloudy, with rain and showers.
Najviše padavina očekuje se na jugu i jugozapadu zemlje.
The most precipitation is expected in the south and southwest of the country.
Jugo će donijeti temperature više od prosjeka za ovo doba godine.
The jugo will bring temperatures above average for this time of year.
Najniže temperature bit će od 7 do 13, a najviše od 12 do 17 stepeni.
The lowest temperatures will be from 7 to 13, and the highest from 12 to 17 degrees.
Na jugu Hercegovine moglo bi biti i do 20 stepeni.
In the south of Herzegovina it could be up to 20 degrees.
Ujutro je moguća magla u kotlinama i uz rijeke, posebno u utorak i petak.
In the morning fog is possible in valleys and along rivers, especially on Tuesday and Friday.
U petak i za vikend na sjeveru i u centralnim dijelovima postepeno će se razvedravati.
On Friday and over the weekend it will gradually clear up in the north and central parts.
Početkom naredne sedmice vrijeme će biti nestabilno, s kišom i malo nižim temperaturama.
At the beginning of next week the weather will be unstable, with rain and slightly lower temperatures.
Krajem mjeseca snijeg je moguć i u višim i u nižim krajevima Bosne.
At the end of the month snow is possible in both higher and lower areas of Bosnia.
Tada bi najniže temperature mogle pasti od -2 do 3 stepena.
Then the lowest temperatures could fall to between -2 and 3 degrees.

title: Bihać objavio program koncerata za Winter Park
Bihać announces the concert programme for Winter Park
body: Grad Bihać objavio je program manifestacije Winter Park, koja traje od 24. decembra do 1. januara.
The city of Bihać has announced the programme of the Winter Park event, which lasts from 24 December to 1 January.
Svake večeri nastupaju poznati muzičari iz BiH i regije.
Every evening well-known musicians from BiH and the region perform.
Novu godinu publika će dočekati uz grupu Dubioza kolektiv.
The audience will welcome the New Year with the group Dubioza kolektiv.
Festival 24. decembra otvaraju Divlje jagode, a dan kasnije nastupa Ilma Karahmet.
Divlje jagode open the festival on 24 December, and a day later Ilma Karahmet performs.
Grupa Let 3 svira 26. decembra, a Željko Samardžić dolazi 27. decembra.
The group Let 3 plays on 26 December, and Željko Samardžić comes on 27 December.
Publika će zatim slušati Adija Šošu, Parni valjak i pjevačicu Vannu.
The audience will then listen to Adi Šoše, Parni valjak and the singer Vanna.
Na Staru godinu nastupaju i Belo Kopče i dva DJ-a, a Dubioza kolektiv izlazi na binu u 23:00.
On New Year's Eve Belo Kopče and two DJs also perform, and Dubioza kolektiv goes on stage at 23:00.
Festival 1. januara zatvara beogradska grupa Galija.
The Belgrade group Galija closes the festival on 1 January.
Prije Winter Parka u gradu će biti još nekoliko koncerata, među njima i božićni koncert 19. decembra.
Before Winter Park there will be several more concerts in the city, among them a Christmas concert on 19 December.
Cijene ulaznica u tekstu nisu navedene.
Ticket prices are not given in the article.

title: Katić trenirao na kiši u majici kratkih rukava
Katić trained in the rain in a short-sleeved shirt
body: Fudbaleri reprezentacije BiH trenirali su na jakoj kiši u kampu FK Sarajevo na Butmiru.
The BiH national team footballers trained in heavy rain at the FK Sarajevo camp in Butmir.
Većina igrača nosila je duksericu, a neki su na glavi imali i kapuljaču.
Most players wore a sweatshirt, and some also had a hood on their head.
Nikola Katić je ipak trčao po kiši samo u majici kratkih rukava.
Nikola Katić, however, ran in the rain in just a short-sleeved shirt.
Reprezentacija se u nedjelju navečer vratila iz Stockholma i odmah je počela s treningom.
The national team returned from Stockholm on Sunday evening and started training straight away.
Tako su počele pripreme za posljednju, šestu utakmicu Lige nacija protiv Rumunije.
That is how preparations began for the last, sixth Nations League match against Romania.
Utakmica se igra u utorak, 17. novembra, na stadionu Bilino polje u Zenici od 20:45.
The match will be played on Tuesday, 17 November, at the Bilino polje stadium in Zenica from 20:45.
Prijenos uživo imaju BHT i MY TV.
BHT and MY TV have the live broadcast.
Katić je i ranije privukao pažnju jer mu hladno vrijeme ne smeta.
Katić has drawn attention before because cold weather does not bother him.
U Njemačkoj su ga zbog toga zvali „ledeni čovjek“.
In Germany they called him "the ice man" because of that.
Igrači danas od 18:00 treniraju na stadionu Asim Ferhatović Hase.
The players train today from 18:00 at the Asim Ferhatović Hase stadium.

title: U Beogradu zapaljen automobil pjevačice Aleksandre Prijović
Singer Aleksandra Prijović's car set on fire in Belgrade
body: Automobil pjevačice Aleksandre Prijović i njenog supruga Filipa Živojinovića zapaljen je u Beogradu.
The car of singer Aleksandra Prijović and her husband Filip Živojinović was set on fire in Belgrade.
To se dogodilo u noći s nedjelje na ponedjeljak u naselju Bežanijska kosa.
It happened in the night from Sunday to Monday in the Bežanijska kosa neighbourhood.
Automobil je bio parkiran odmah pored kuće u kojoj par živi.
The car was parked right next to the house where the couple lives.
Vatra se proširila i na drugi automobil koji je stajao pored.
The fire also spread to another car that was standing next to it.
Na mjesto su došli vatrogasci i policija.
Firefighters and police came to the scene.
Policija je počela istragu i prikuplja dokaze kako bi otkrila šta se tačno dogodilo.
The police have started an investigation and are collecting evidence to find out what exactly happened.
Policajci su također čuvali ulaz u kuću para.
Police officers also guarded the entrance to the couple's house.
Portal Telegraf.rs objavio je snimak na kojem se vidi da su Prijović i Živojinović uznemireni.
The Telegraf.rs portal published a video in which you can see that Prijović and Živojinović are upset.
Oni su stajali ispred svoje kuće dok su vatrogasci radili.
They were standing in front of their house while the firefighters worked.
Za sada nije poznato ko je zapalio automobil ni zašto.
For now it is not known who set the car on fire or why.

title: Novo Predsjedništvo BiH danas preuzima dužnost
The new Presidency of BiH takes office today
body: Novi članovi Predsjedništva BiH danas u 16:00 sati u Sarajevu preuzimaju dužnost.
The new members of the Presidency of BiH take office today at 16:00 in Sarajevo.
To su Denis Bećirović, Darijana Filipović i Željka Cvijanović, a njihov mandat traje do 2030. godine.
They are Denis Bećirović, Darijana Filipović and Željka Cvijanović, and their term lasts until 2030.
Bećirović i Cvijanović počinju drugi mandat zaredom, dok je Filipović nova u Predsjedništvu.
Bećirović and Cvijanović are starting their second term in a row, while Filipović is new in the Presidency.
Kandidatkinja HDZ-a BiH Filipović dolazi na mjesto Željka Komšića, koji je bio član Predsjedništva četiri mandata.
HDZ BiH candidate Filipović takes the place of Željko Komšić, who was a member of the Presidency for four terms.
Na sjednici će dobiti uvjerenja, a zatim će potpisati svečanu izjavu.
At the session they will receive certificates and then sign a solemn declaration.
Opšti izbori su održani 4. oktobra, a Centralna izborna komisija potvrdila je rezultate 3. novembra.
The general elections were held on 4 October, and the Central Election Commission confirmed the results on 3 November.
Cvijanović je dobila 319.705 glasova, Bećirović 222.484, a Filipović 120.701 glas.
Cvijanović won 319,705 votes, Bećirović 222,484 and Filipović 120,701 votes.
Prema pravilima, predsjedavajući postaje član koji je sljedeći na redu, osim ako se članovi drugačije dogovore.
According to the rules, the chair goes to the member who is next in line, unless the members agree otherwise.
Predsjedništvo vodi vanjsku politiku i imenuje ambasadore.
The Presidency conducts foreign policy and appoints ambassadors.
Ono također predstavlja BiH u međunarodnim organizacijama i predlaže godišnji budžet parlamentu.
It also represents BiH in international organisations and proposes the annual budget to parliament.

title: Chelsea i dalje želi Alajbegovića, Juventus ga ne pušta
Chelsea still wants Alajbegović, Juventus won't let him go
body: Engleski klub Chelsea nije odustao od reprezentativca BiH Kerima Alajbegovića.
The English club Chelsea has not given up on BiH international Kerim Alajbegović.
Talijanski list Gazzetta dello Sport piše da ljudi iz Chelseaja pažljivo prate mladog igrača.
The Italian paper Gazzetta dello Sport writes that people from Chelsea are closely watching the young player.
Juventus se zato već sprema da ga zadrži ako u januaru stigne ponuda iz Premier lige.
That is why Juventus is already getting ready to keep him if an offer from the Premier League arrives in January.
Prošlog ljeta Alajbegović je bio vrlo blizu prelaska u Chelsea.
Last summer Alajbegović was very close to a move to Chelsea.
Ipak, Juventus je brzo reagovao i za bivšeg igrača Bayer Leverkusena platio 30 miliona eura.
However, Juventus reacted quickly and paid 30 million euros for the former Bayer Leverkusen player.
Alajbegović ima ugovor s Juventusom do 2031. godine.
Alajbegović has a contract with Juventus until 2031.
Trener Luciano Spalletti i uprava kluba smatraju da je on nezamjenjiv igrač.
Coach Luciano Spalletti and the club's management consider him an irreplaceable player.
Prema listu, trenutno nema pregovora, ali Juventus zna da interes postoji.
According to the paper, there are no negotiations at the moment, but Juventus knows the interest exists.
Gazzetta očekuje da će klub odbiti svaku ponudu do kraja januarskog prijelaznog roka.
Gazzetta expects the club to reject every offer until the end of the January transfer window.
Prije utakmice BiH protiv Švedske Juventus je Alajbegoviću poslao posebnu poruku podrške.
Before BiH's match against Sweden, Juventus sent Alajbegović a special message of support.

title: Stiže jugo s jakim udarima i kišom
The jugo wind is coming with strong gusts and rain
body: U Bosni i Hercegovini danas će biti uglavnom oblačno, s kišom i pljuskovima.
In Bosnia and Herzegovina today it will be mostly cloudy, with rain and showers.
Najviše kiše očekuje se u Hercegovini, javlja Federalni hidrometeorološki zavod.
The most rain is expected in Herzegovina, reports the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute.
Puhat će južni vjetar, a povremeno su mogući i jaki udari juga.
A southern wind will blow, and at times strong gusts of the jugo are also possible.
Jugo je topao vjetar koji puše s juga, od mora.
The jugo is a warm wind that blows from the south, from the sea.
Jutarnje temperature bit će od 3 do 8 stepeni, a na jugu do 14.
Morning temperatures will be from 3 to 8 degrees, and in the south up to 14.
Najviše dnevne temperature bit će od 10 do 15, a na jugu do 18 stepeni.
The highest daytime temperatures will be from 10 to 15, and in the south up to 18 degrees.
U Sarajevu se ujutro očekuje oko 6, a tokom dana oko 12 stepeni.
In Sarajevo around 6 degrees is expected in the morning, and around 12 during the day.
U utorak će biti djelimično sunčano, ali ujutro može biti magle u dolinama.
On Tuesday it will be partly sunny, but in the morning there may be fog in the valleys.
Navečer opet počinje kiša, koja će biti najjača u Hercegovini i na zapadu Bosne.
In the evening rain starts again, and it will be heaviest in Herzegovina and in the west of Bosnia.
U srijedu će biti znatno toplije, s temperaturama do 20 stepeni, ali i s kišom i jakim vjetrom.
On Wednesday it will be noticeably warmer, with temperatures up to 20 degrees, but also with rain and strong wind.

title: Šta najbogatiji Rusi žele nakon Putina
What the richest Russians want after Putin
body: BBC je objavio analizu o tome kakvu Rusiju žele najbogatiji ljudi u zemlji nakon Vladimira Putina.
The BBC published an analysis of what kind of Russia the richest people in the country want after Vladimir Putin.
Prema magazinu Forbes, Rusija ima 155 milijardera koji zajedno imaju skoro 700 milijardi dolara.
According to Forbes magazine, Russia has 155 billionaires who together have almost 700 billion dollars.
Putin je u prvim godinama vlasti, nakon 2000. godine, stavio bogate biznismene pod svoju kontrolu.
In his first years in power, after 2000, Putin put rich businessmen under his control.
Na dan napada na Ukrajinu 2022. godine Putin je u Kremlju tražio od milijardera podršku za rat, a niko nije ništa rekao.
On the day of the attack on Ukraine in 2022, Putin asked billionaires in the Kremlin for support for the war, and nobody said anything.
Oni koji su kritikovali rat izgubili su imovinu, a lojalni su dobili unosne državne ugovore.
Those who criticised the war lost their property, and the loyal ones got lucrative state contracts.
Andrej Meljničenko, najbogatiji proizvođač gnojiva u Rusiji, dao je rijedak intervju magazinu The Economist.
Andrei Melnichenko, the richest fertiliser producer in Russia, gave a rare interview to The Economist magazine.
Rekao je da je potreban kraj vladavine jednog čovjeka i više otvorenosti prema svijetu.
He said that an end to one-man rule and more openness to the world are needed.
Analitičari kažu da mnogi bogati Rusi žele povratak u devedesete, kada su imali više utjecaja.
Analysts say that many rich Russians want a return to the nineties, when they had more influence.
Ako Putin ode, vlast bi privremeno preuzeo premijer Mihail Mišustin.
If Putin leaves, Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin would temporarily take over power.
Kritičar Kremlja Bill Browder misli da bogataši neće ništa uraditi dok je Putin živ, jer se boje zatvora.
Kremlin critic Bill Browder thinks the rich will do nothing while Putin is alive, because they are afraid of prison.

title: Vladine snage u Jemenu napustile važan moreuz
Government forces in Yemen leave an important strait
body: Vladine snage u Jemenu, koje podržava Saudijska Arabija, potvrdile su da se povlače s područja kod moreuza Bab al-Mandeb.
Government forces in Yemen, which are backed by Saudi Arabia, confirmed that they are withdrawing from the area near the Bab al-Mandeb strait.
Moreuz je uski morski prolaz na jugu Crvenog mora, a sada ga ponovo kontrolišu Huti.
A strait is a narrow sea passage, this one at the south of the Red Sea, and the Houthis control it again now.
Hute podržava Iran, a oni su ovo područje zauzeli iznenadnim napadom u septembru.
The Houthis are backed by Iran, and they took this area in a surprise attack in September.
Vojska je saopćila da vojnici idu braniti Aden, privremeni glavni grad zemlje.
The army said the soldiers are going to defend Aden, the country's temporary capital.
Prema agenciji Reuters, jedinice napuštaju aerodrom Dhubab i cijelo područje oko moreuza.
According to the Reuters agency, the units are leaving Dhubab airport and the whole area around the strait.
Kao razlog su naveli potrebu da ojačaju linije fronta, a Aden je za njih apsolutni prioritet.
As the reason they gave the need to strengthen the front lines, and Aden is the absolute priority for them.
Ovim povlačenjem završila je ofanziva koju su vladine snage vodile nekoliko sedmica.
With this withdrawal the offensive that government forces had led for several weeks came to an end.
Mediji pod kontrolom Huta potvrdili su da su njihove snage preuzele potpunu kontrolu nad područjem.
Media controlled by the Houthis confirmed that their forces had taken full control of the area.
Saudijska Arabija do objave vijesti nije komentarisala situaciju.
Saudi Arabia had not commented on the situation by the time the news was published.

title: Tri jutarnje navike koje stvaraju stres
Three morning habits that create stress
body: Stručnjaci za mentalno zdravlje kažu da tri navike mogu dan početi s nepotrebnim stresom.
Mental health experts say that three habits can start the day with unnecessary stress.
Savjete su za magazin Real Simple dale savjetnica Mindy DeSeta i terapeutkinja Christine Hathaway.
The advice was given to Real Simple magazine by counsellor Mindy DeSeta and therapist Christine Hathaway.
Prva loša navika je gledanje u telefon čim se probudimo.
The first bad habit is looking at the phone as soon as we wake up.
DeSeta kaže da poruke i društvene mreže odmah ujutro stvaraju osjećaj da moramo nešto riješiti.
DeSeta says that messages and social networks first thing in the morning create a feeling that we have to deal with something.
Zato savjetuje da telefon ne koristimo barem 30 minuta i da ga punimo izvan spavaće sobe.
That is why she advises us not to use the phone for at least 30 minutes and to charge it outside the bedroom.
Druga navika je jutro bez rutine, kada svaku odluku donosimo u zadnji čas.
The second habit is a morning without a routine, when we make every decision at the last moment.
Hathaway kaže da tada lako zaboravimo stvari, preskočimo doručak i žurimo kroz vrata.
Hathaway says that then we easily forget things, skip breakfast and rush out the door.
Treća navika je odgađanje alarma, jer pet minuta dodatnog sna ne donosi pravi odmor.
The third habit is snoozing the alarm, because five minutes of extra sleep does not bring real rest.
Stručnjakinje savjetuju da alarm stavimo na drugi kraj sobe, kako bismo morali ustati.
The experts advise putting the alarm on the other side of the room, so that we have to get up.
Također je važno ići na vrijeme u krevet i spavati sedam do osam sati.
It is also important to go to bed on time and sleep seven to eight hours.

title: Slovenija uvodi kamere koje mjere prosječnu brzinu
Slovenia introduces cameras that measure average speed
body: Na slovenskim autoputevima uskoro će raditi kamere koje mjere brzinu na cijeloj dionici puta.
Cameras that measure speed along a whole section of road will soon be working on Slovenian motorways.
Sistem je postavljen na četiri dionice oko Ljubljane, a svaka mjeri brzinu samo u jednom smjeru.
The system has been installed on four sections around Ljubljana, and each measures speed in one direction only.
Kazne se za sada ne izdaju, jer predaja sistema policiji još nije završena.
No fines are being issued for now, because the handover of the system to the police has not been finished yet.
Kamera na početku dionice snimi vozilo i vrijeme ulaska, a kamera na kraju vrijeme izlaska.
A camera at the start of the section records the vehicle and the time of entry, and a camera at the end the time of exit.
Sistem iz dužine dionice i vremena vožnje izračuna prosječnu brzinu.
From the length of the section and the driving time, the system calculates the average speed.
Zato kočenje ispred kamere neće pomoći vozaču koji je prije toga vozio prebrzo.
That is why braking in front of a camera will not help a driver who drove too fast before that.
Ako vozač na autoputu pređe ograničenje za više od 60 km/h, kazna je 1.200 eura i devet kaznenih bodova.
If a driver on the motorway goes more than 60 km/h over the limit, the fine is 1,200 euros and nine penalty points.
Slovenska kompanija za autoputeve DARS kaže da cilj nije kažnjavanje, nego veća sigurnost u saobraćaju.
The Slovenian motorway company DARS says that the goal is not punishment, but more safety in traffic.
Policija će odrediti datum početka i o tome ranije obavijestiti vozače.
The police will set the start date and inform drivers about it in advance.
Prosječnu brzinu na ovim dionicama vozači mogu pratiti u besplatnoj aplikaciji AMZS-a.
Drivers can follow the average speed on these sections in AMZS's free app.

title: Kuluševski objavio fotografiju s Edinom Džekom
Kulusevski posted a photo with Edin Džeko
body: Švedski nogometaš Dejan Kuluševski objavio je na Instagramu fotografiju s Edinom Džekom.
Swedish footballer Dejan Kulusevski posted a photo with Edin Džeko on Instagram.
Na slici se obojica smiju, a Kuluševski je dodao emotikone krune i srca.
Both are smiling in the picture, and Kulusevski added crown and heart emojis.
On je u subotu prvi put nakon 725 dana igrao za Švedsku, i to protiv BiH.
On Saturday he played for Sweden for the first time in 725 days, and it was against BiH.
Švedska je na poluvremenu vodila 3:0, ali je BiH u drugom poluvremenu smanjila na 2:3.
Sweden led 3:0 at half-time, but BiH cut the lead to 2:3 in the second half.
Golove za BiH dali su Armin Gigović i Sead Kolašinac.
Armin Gigović and Sead Kolašinac scored the goals for BiH.
Kuluševski je u igru ušao nakon sat vremena, jer se vraća nakon teške povrede koljena.
Kulusevski came into the game after an hour, because he is coming back after a serious knee injury.
Džeko se od reprezentacije oprostio 2. oktobra u Zenici, upravo protiv Švedske.
Džeko said goodbye to the national team on 2 October in Zenica, against Sweden of all teams.
Kuluševski je rekao da je kraj utakmice bio previše uzbudljiv, ali da je pobjeda najvažnija.
Kulusevski said that the end of the match was too exciting, but that the win is the most important thing.
Dodao je da je atmosfera bila kao na velikom takmičenju.
He added that the atmosphere was like at a big tournament.
Švedska je osvojila prvo mjesto u grupi, a u utorak igra u Poljskoj.
Sweden won first place in the group, and on Tuesday it plays in Poland.

title: Stotine hiljada Čeha protestovale za javni radio i televiziju
Hundreds of thousands of Czechs protested for public radio and television
body: Stotine hiljada ljudi okupile su se u nedjelju u Pragu na velikom protestu.
Hundreds of thousands of people gathered on Sunday in Prague at a big protest.
Protestovali su protiv plana vlade Andreja Babiša da promijeni finansiranje javnog radija i televizije.
They protested against the plan of Andrej Babiš’s government to change the funding of public radio and television.
Skup je održan u parku Letná, gdje su ljudi protestovali i 1989. godine.
The rally was held in Letná park, where people also protested in 1989.
Organizatori kažu da je na protestu bilo oko 350.000 ljudi.
The organisers say that there were about 350,000 people at the protest.
Prema planu, javni mediji bi dobijali novac iz državnog budžeta, a ne od taksi koje plaćaju građani.
According to the plan, public media would get money from the state budget, and not from fees that citizens pay.
Dobili bi oko 15 posto manje novca, pa bi neki ljudi mogli ostati bez posla.
They would get about 15 percent less money, so some people could lose their jobs.
Kritičari misle da bi vlada tako mogla preuzeti kontrolu nad medijima, kao u Slovačkoj i Mađarskoj.
Critics think that the government could in this way take control of the media, as in Slovakia and Hungary.
Parlament je prvu verziju zakona izglasao 24. oktobra u 4:36 ujutro.
Parliament voted for the first version of the law on 24 October at 4:36 in the morning.
Nakon toga su zaposleni u javnim medijima 3. novembra stupili u štrajk.
After that, employees of public media went on strike on 3 November.
Babiš je rekao da će nastaviti s planom i da to neće ugroziti slobodu medija.
Babiš said that he would continue with the plan and that it would not threaten media freedom.

title: Bh. muzičar Vedran Vexon oduševio žiri na Supertalentu
BiH musician Vedran Vexon thrilled the jury on Supertalent
body: Muzičar Vedran Tomičić, poznatiji kao Vedran Vexon, nastupio je u hrvatskoj emisiji „Supertalent“.
Musician Vedran Tomičić, better known as Vedran Vexon, performed on the Croatian show “Supertalent”.
Pjevao je pjesmu „Stanica Podlugovi“ Zdravka Čolića i oduševio žiri i publiku.
He sang the song “Stanica Podlugovi” by Zdravko Čolić and thrilled the jury and the audience.
Publika je ustala već na prvom refrenu i pljeskala do kraja pjesme.
The audience stood up already at the first chorus and clapped until the end of the song.
Vexon ima 43 godine i godinama je nastupao kao pjevač i gitarista u bendu.
Vexon is 43 years old and for years performed as a singer and guitarist in a band.
Na takmičenje se prijavio slučajno, a odgovor mu je stigao u spam.
He applied for the competition by chance, and the reply came to his spam folder.
Iako je dobio prolaz od žirija, nije pozvan u polufinale.
Although he got through with the jury, he was not invited to the semi-final.
Objasnio je da se mnogo pjevača, mađioničara i plesača bori za malo mjesta.
He explained that many singers, magicians and dancers compete for few places.
Solo karijeru je počeo tek 2024. godine pjesmom „Kap u kiši“.
He started his solo career only in 2024 with the song “Kap u kiši”.
Nedavno je objavio novi singl „Tišina od glasa“, za koji je sam napisao muziku i tekst.
He recently released a new single “Tišina od glasa”, for which he wrote the music and lyrics himself.
Rekao je da je danas teško uspjeti, ali da nikada ne treba odustati.
He said that it is hard to succeed today, but that one should never give up.
Drugim muzičarima savjetuje da se prijave na takva takmičenja.
He advises other musicians to apply for such competitions.

title: Iranski ajatolah A’rafi govorio o vezama Irana i BiH
Iranian ayatollah A’rafi spoke about ties between Iran and BiH
body: Iranski vjerski lider ajatolah Alireza A’rafi ovih dana boravi u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Iranian religious leader Ayatollah Alireza A’rafi is in Bosnia and Herzegovina these days.
Došao je na poziv Islamske zajednice, na svečanost za novog reisul-ulemu.
He came at the invitation of the Islamic Community, for a ceremony for the new reis-ul-ulema.
U intervjuu za Klix.ba govorio je o ratu u kojem je Iran napadnut i o odnosima s BiH.
In an interview for Klix.ba he spoke about the war in which Iran was attacked and about relations with BiH.
A’rafi je član Vijeća čuvara ustava i od 2016. godine vodi sve vjerske škole u Iranu.
A’rafi is a member of the Guardian Council and has led all religious schools in Iran since 2016.
U martu 2026. godine kratko je bio u privremenom vodstvu zemlje, nakon pogibije vrhovnog vođe Alija Hameneija.
In March 2026 he was briefly part of the country’s interim leadership, after the death of supreme leader Ali Khamenei.
Rekao je da Iran uvijek podržava pregovore, ali da je Donald Trump uništio povjerenje u njih.
He said that Iran always supports negotiations, but that Donald Trump destroyed trust in them.
Prema njegovim riječima, SAD je dva puta napao Iran dok su pregovori još trajali.
According to him, the US attacked Iran twice while the negotiations were still going on.
A’rafi je rekao da Iran gleda na BiH s posebnom ljubavi i da želi bolje odnose.
A’rafi said that Iran looks at BiH with special love and wants better relations.
Dodao je da se o ratu u BiH uči na iranskim fakultetima i univerzitetima.
He added that the war in BiH is studied at Iranian faculties and universities.
Zemlje bi, kako kaže, mogle više sarađivati u kulturi, umjetnosti, poeziji i filozofiji.
The countries, he says, could cooperate more in culture, art, poetry and philosophy.

title: Sukob policije i mladih na protestu u Berlinu
Clash between police and young people at a protest in Berlin
body: U subotu navečer u Berlinu došlo je do sukoba između policije i mladih demonstranata.
On Saturday evening in Berlin there was a clash between police and young demonstrators.
Protest je organizovala inicijativa „Gen Z regelt“, koja je protiv obaveznog vojnog roka.
The protest was organised by the initiative “Gen Z regelt”, which is against compulsory military service.
Oni protestuju i protiv loših uslova u školama i rezova na univerzitetima.
They also protest against bad conditions in schools and cuts at universities.
Skup je bio prijavljen za 100 ljudi, ali je kroz grad prošlo oko 1.200 učesnika.
The rally was registered for 100 people, but about 1,200 participants went through the city.
Na terenu je bilo oko 700 policajaca, a kolona je više puta zaustavljena.
There were about 700 police officers on the ground, and the march was stopped several times.
Policija kaže da su učesnici pokušali probiti policijski lanac prije polaska.
The police say that the participants tried to break through the police line before setting off.
Privremeno je uhapšeno 20 osoba, a povrijeđena su 3 policajca.
Twenty people were temporarily arrested, and 3 police officers were injured.
Organizatori su rekli da je skup bio miran i da su protiv nasilja.
The organisers said that the rally was peaceful and that they are against violence.
Krajem oktobra ista inicijativa je organizovala proteste u više od 30 njemačkih gradova.
At the end of October the same initiative organised protests in more than 30 German cities.
Za 20. novembar najavljen je evropski štrajk mladih, a samo u Berlinu očekuje se 15.000 ljudi.
A European youth strike has been announced for 20 November, and 15,000 people are expected in Berlin alone.
